clean_body: | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | 17 October 2026 | | | Conforti Grassroots Newsletter | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Welcome to the final stretch of our campaign! .With the 2026 Midterm Election just weeks away, this interactive grassroots newsletter is your central hub for the final push to bring true representation back to the hardworking constituents of Illinois' 6th Congressional District. .Our campaign has always been built on a "district-first" mentality, prioritizing your needs through sensible solutions and open dialogue. Now, we need your help to cross the finish line. As we continue to provide you with regular updates on policy, campaign events, and current community events happening right here in our district, your active participation is more critical than ever. .Please click the button below to make a donation today—your grassroots contributions are what make this possible. | | | | | | Special Release. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | The Conforti Brief | | Informing voters on current events and how Niki plans to help them once in office. | | Standing With Female Athletes: Condemning Threats and Protecting Title IX. Recently, Fox News and OutKick reported on an alarming and unacceptable incident involving 20-year-old NCAA softball player Kendall Kotzmacher. Because of her public advocacy against biological males competing in girls' and women's sports , the Colorado Christian University sophomore revealed that someone threatened to come to her college campus and threatened her life. In addition to the police-investigated death threat, Kotzmacher has endured a barrage of online harassment telling her she does not deserve to live, with online targeting even spreading to her supportive teammates. Her advocacy began after her high school team lost a 2025 state semifinal game to a team featuring a transgender pitcher, and she has since traveled to Capitol Hill—where Democrat lawmakers largely walked out on or ignored female athletes sharing their stories —to fight for fairness and safety for the next generation of young women. .Lawmakers must condemn these vile threats and intimidation tactics against women who are speaking out for their fundamental rights. No young woman should ever fear for her life, face harassment, or be bullied into silence simply for wanting nothing more than the opportunity to compete on a fair and safe playing field. .For decades, female athletes have worked tirelessly to achieve equality in athletics. Protecting these hard-won opportunities is a matter of defending the sanctity of fairness and the important rights owed to women under Title IX. Unfortunately, incumbent Democrat Sean Casten and his party have threatened the integrity of women’s sports and the foundational protections of Title IX. Instead of standing up for female athletes and common-sense fairness, Casten is more concerned with partisan messaging and satisfying the most radical elements of his party—pushing a far-left agenda that is directly in opposition with the values of his constituents in Illinois' 6th Congressional District. By refusing to protect biological women’s spaces and sports, Casten and his allies have eroded the very equality Title IX was created to guarantee. .As your candidate for Illinois' 6th Congressional District, Niki Conforti maintains a "district-first" mentality and firmly believes that equal opportunities for women mean female athletes deserve to compete on a fair playing field —without being forced to compete against biological males. . When elected to represent the 6th District in the U.S. House of Representatives, Niki will take action to protect women's sports, supporting policies like: . Supporting the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act: Proudly supporting legislation like S.9, the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act, to prevent biological males from competing against biological females in athletic competitions. This crucial measure provides positive protections and ensures the integrity of women's sports is maintained. Defending the Sanctity of Title IX: Work to ensure that the important rights owed to women athletes under Title IX of the Education Amendments are fiercely protected from radical partisan overreach. Ensuring Safe and Fair Competition: Niki will fight to guarantee that every young woman in our district has the chance to compete, excel, and be recognized fairly for her dedication and hard work—free from intimidation and unfair biological disadvantages. . Children are our future, and we must protect them. It is time to stand with brave female athletes across our nation , demand accountability, and ensure that equality in women's sports is grounded in a fair playing field. name: Wes Moore
subject: About saying goodbye
body:
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=2131%2E1086043%2EoR3OpA)
This is a longer email about saying goodbye, Peter, but if you don’t have time to read through, I would deeply appreciate **[a contribution to power our campaign for the final 17 days of this election.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20261017-1.HD_-WC&refcode=em-20261017-1&t=2&akid=2131%2E1086043%2EoR3OpA)**
After nearly a century of operation, Valley Forge Military Academy — the place where I went to school and grew from an angry, complicated child to a confident young man — has closed.
When my mother first sent me to the Forge, she saw military school as a last resort in response to a seemingly endless chain of misbehavior, both at home and at school. At age 11, I’d already felt handcuffs on my wrists. **I was not on a path to success.**
There was no overnight miracle when I started school there, but slowly, things changed. I learned about honor, code, and service. I started to take an interest in campus life, academics, and leadership positions — and I rose up the ranks and became a first captain in command of around 800 cadets.
After graduation, I went on to study at Johns Hopkins and Oxford, deployed to Afghanistan with the 82nd Airborne Division, ran one of the largest poverty-fighting organizations in the country, and now, I serve as the 63rd governor of Maryland _and the first Black governor in the history of my state._
What saddens me most isn’t losing a place I once called home. My memories will forever live on with me.
**It saddens me that other young men like me will have one fewer avenue to challenge themselves and build their own pathway to success.**
Peter, at a time where our young men and boys are falling behind and feeling isolated, we have to offer more paths for connection and engagement.
I know Valley Forge Military Academy did that for me, and I’m determined to find ways to do that for young Marylanders today.
That includes the **Maryland Corps and Service Year Option** — the first statewide program in the country to give high school graduates a year of paid, full-time community service on the path to college or a career.
We have to help young Marylanders find the thing that guides them on a pathway to success and that inspires them to serve. **[If you support that mission, I would appreciate a donation to keep me in the fight as Maryland's governor today.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20261017-1.HD_-WC&refcode=em-20261017-1&t=3&akid=2131%2E1086043%2EoR3OpA)**
Elevate,
Wes
[](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20261017-1.HD_-WC&refcode=em-20261017-1&t=4&akid=2131%2E1086043%2EoR3OpA)

* * *
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-footer?refcode=em-20261017-1&t=5&refcode2=2131_1086043_oR3OpA&akid=2131%2E1086043%2EoR3OpA)**

clean_body: Until 2018, no Indigenous woman had ever served in Congress Until 2018, no Indigenous woman had ever served in Congress | ~~ | | Peter, Here's a number worth sitting with this Saturday morning: for the first 229 years of Congress, zero Indigenous American women had ever served. Then 2018 happened. Sharice Davids and Deb Haaland were elected the same night, becoming the first two ever. Then, in 2022, Mary Peltola became the first Alaska Native in Congress. And now look at this November: five Indigenous women are on one ballot. Sharice is defending her seat. Claire Valdez is ready to join her in the House. Mary fighting for the Senate seat that decides the majority. Peggy Flanagan is a victory away from becoming the first Indigenous woman EVER in the Senate, alongside Mary. And Deb Haaland is ready to win the New Mexico governorship. From zero to five, in eight years. That's a movement, built election by election, funded by people who decided the number should never be zero again. ~ If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | ~~ Thank you. — Indigenous Women Lead | Paid for by Indigenous Women Lead PAC Indigenous Women Lead PACPO Box 15845Washington, DC 20003United States

Friend,

**I hate this part.**

I've told you about my career in public service, raising two young daughters with my wife, and running a small business near our home in North Carolina.

[](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=d2765b5f0f0f408cbca8a3bc6a4efb43&_e=5qk3Z9nn1TK2Pqj7B6rATX6XEho7W8HgWjX6GS_-TrFl29uA8V8gWegYzoxliP_iZLIE8Bhn47fBxQeIAOFtDv5yDBBVtEnqMHO4lPT_I1rHSUBcoFUOgzkVHcN2O9nUe4JXKlbOZftD3HzhlamUw4utwm4TdcAJY-cJqyZ95Fk21b3eE-6OYiK3MCY84uB9zvSjoTuOswLO9g2EqfBF_-UYu1FGUmvQSbn3RUKgDMft4U9Y9sKiUlbPQPJIJaNN6lykrZC2KZmXazTNYafdSIfgbvFPZOcB9d0EWLxaorhrijC2M1JZQJ49a7vSGMphmqlVwjgLn9u_bswoUSvdMtzC3SVi2Kue-WMn0yCVqOuQAplTu-0mdTDUY-Ke8dUrKRhxwbjedXb8yf0jMx0daj03OhrNGrxIi8V6VuFM8TPrmeezZu_w0lfOJwhViIopTy8EF6DtYByskz3HPjE4anqh7FK_QwIPMjhzhE_8M27xilloR0diw7TUuj6S0M5ecFt55kecYvwY-pM8IrRlap3krJvNc_T0AcNXJ7wDirw%3D)
I could talk to you all day about faith, family, and freedom, and even firearms, but I HATE talking to you about finances.

**There, I said it -_campaign finances_ , to be exact. **

Running for Congress to serve you, protect families like mine, and make our nation great again is truly such an honor. body:
What this says about this moment in America | | | |
---
| | | Peter,
---
Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth.

He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him.

He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country.

That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt.

**That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,_Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith._**

Peter, this book isn't just about JD Vance's story...

It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now.

So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together.

Young people face that pressure every single day.

They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is.

JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion.

He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back.

That's what _Communion_ is about...

And it gets to the heart of what so many families are watching happen in the lives of their children and grandchildren right now.

That's why Turning Point USA is reaching young people where this battle is actually being fought -- on campuses, in classrooms, and in a culture that keeps pressuring them to walk away from faith.

clean_body: What this says about this moment in America | | | | | | | Peter, Faith is essential to the survival and success of America. Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth. He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him. He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country. That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt. That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith. Peter, this book isn't just about JD Vance's story... It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now. So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together. Young people face that pressure every single day. They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is. JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion. He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back. That's what Communion is about... And it gets to the heart of what so many families are watching happen in the lives of their children and grandchildren right now. That's why Turning Point USA is reaching young people where this battle is actually being fought -- on campuses, in classrooms, and in a culture that keeps pressuring them to walk away from faith. Your support does far more than just send you a book... It helps Turning Point USA reach young people in the very places where faith is under attack. Because of supporters like you, students on more than 5,000 campuses are hearing something they may not hear anywhere else: a serious defense of faith, truth, and a life rooted in God. For many of them, that's the first time anyone has challenged the lies they have been fed. And for many of them, that's where their minds begin to change -- and so do their lives. Charlie believed the next generation was worth fighting for. He believed young people were not beyond reach -- they needed someone willing to meet them where this battle is being fought and tell them the truth clearly and directly. That's why your support matters. It helps Turning Point USA keep showing up. And it helps carry forward the mission Charlie gave his life to build. | | | Now's the time to act. First, read this chart in two eras:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/23fd0fc8-f74d-4c75-8f21-a1a23fc75ed1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

The line tells two different stories. From 1967 to about 2010 there is a long, steady, almost mechanical slide -- the mainline slope. Then, after 2020, the curve breaks into a cliff: roughly 6.3 million members in 2020 down to 3.99 million in 2024.
A conservative account has to keep those two eras distinct, because they have different explanations. The cliff is partly surgery -- about 25% of American congregations formally voted to leave between 2019 and 2023 (the Lewis Center's final count put disaffiliations at more than 7,500 churches), plus COVID-era reporting failures where whole conferences simply stopped filing numbers. Much of that loss didn't leave Christianity; it left the denomination, resurfacing in the Global Methodist Church and independent congregations. But the 50-year slope is the real story, and it is where the conservative diagnosis lives. The schism was the symptom; the slope was the disease.
**The root cause: a church that stopped believing its own Book**
The decline begins in the late 1960s, decades before anyone fought over sexuality. What changed first was the seminaries. Methodist seminaries absorbed the higher criticism, then the activist theology, then the ambient mainline assumption that doctrine is negotiable and mission is generic benevolence. A generation of clergy was formed to stand in the pulpit and manage the tradition rather than proclaim it.
Dean Kelley saw this coming in 1972, in 'Why Conservative Churches Are Growing': mainline bodies were dying not despite their moderation but because of it. "Weak religion" -- religion that no longer makes strong, exclusive, costly claims -- cannot summon sacrifice. People will give decades and their tithes and their Sunday mornings to something they believe is true; they will not give those things to a civic club with hymns. The United Methodists had, in effect, started charging nothing for membership because they no longer believed membership cost anything.
That's the biblical logic of Matthew 5:13 -- salt that loses its taste is "no longer good for anything except to be thrown out." The conservative claim is not that God punishes liberalism with bad quarterly reports. It is that a church without convictions has no engine, and the numbers are simply the engine quitting.
**The long hypocrisy: rules without discipline, 1972 -2019**
Here is the part that radicalized the conservative rank and file. The 1972 General Conference added to the Book of Discipline the language that "the practice of homosexuality is incompatible with Christian teaching," and General Conference after General Conference -- including delegates from the growing African conferences -- reaffirmed it, for roughly forty-five years.
The institution, however, never enforced its own law. Bishops declined to file charges; boards of ordained ministry waved through candidates who said plainly they would ignore the Discipline; the Western Jurisdiction elected Karen Oliveto, a married lesbian clergywoman, as a resident bishop in 2016. In 2019, a specially called General Conference in St. Louis passed the Traditional Plan anyway -- and it was, again, simply never enforced.
From a biblical-conservative standpoint, this was the actual apostasy, and it's deeper than any single issue. The New Testament treats church discipline as load-bearing: "purge the evil person from among you" (1 Cor. 5), the binding-and-loosing of Matthew 18, the lampstand threatened with removal for toleration at Thyatira (Rev. 2). A body that writes covenant vows it will not keep has lost the ability to say no -- and a church that cannot say no to anything has no identity, only a brand. By 2019, conservatives had concluded the Book of Discipline was dead paper, and that the denomination was functionally post-doctrinal: whatever it officially taught, nothing bound anyone. Many of the people leaving in 2022-23 will tell you they didn't leave over 2024's votes. They left over 2019's non-enforcement.
**The exit -- and the mask coming off**
When Paragraph 2553 opened the exit door, the most theologically serious congregations walked through it -- disproportionately the high-giving, younger-clergy, growing churches. The Global Methodist Church, launched in 2022, gathered more than 3,000 congregations in its first eighteen months and kept growing. Then the door was closed: the disaffiliation window lapsed at the end of 2023, and the Judicial Council nullified conference separation plans. Those who remained had lost their lever.
The 2024 General Conference in Charlotte then ratified everything the right had alleged: the incompatible language deleted, the bans on self-avowed practicing homosexual clergy removed, funding prohibitions ended, charges related to sexual orientation barred, the revised Social Principles scrubbed of the word "homosexuality," and regionalization adopted -- which, as conservatives read it, restructures the church so the shrinking, liberalizing American wing no longer needs to persuade the growing African conferences it must numerically outvote. After the faithful had left, the institution chose its side. The fight, conservatives conclude, was never about preserving unity; it was about who pays for the lights while the beliefs diverge.
**The theology of decline**
The conservative frame for the whole curve comes from Scripture: "judgment begins at the household of God" (1 Pet. 4:17); "my people are destroyed for lack of knowledge" (Hos. 4:6); the lampstand of Ephesus threatened because they "abandoned the love you had at first" (Rev. 2:4-5); the itching-ears congregation of 2 Timothy 4 that "will not endure sound teaching" and finds teachers to match. The argument is that the United Methodists did not decline because they were too faithful -- because they stood on the Gospel and the culture abandoned them. They declined in exact proportion to the confidence they lost in Scripture itself. Forty years of unbelief yields this yield.
And the conservative account makes room for the remnant: seven thousand in Israel who had not bowed the knee to Baal (1 Kings 19:18). Numbers are not the measure of a church -- the apostolic church was tiny, and faithful churches under persecution in China or Iran are small. The claim is not big equals blessed. It is that this particular decline is not the world persecuting a faithful church; it is God removing an institutional candlestick, while the faithful within it -- the departing congregations, the GMC, the small churches that stayed -- are the part of the story still under grace.
**The caveats a careful conservative keeps**
Three things keep the argument honest. First, the 1967 starting point is a high-water mark inflated by the 1968 merger with the Evangelical United Brethren -- 11 million was never a normal baseline. Second, the 2020-24 cliff overstates the die-off: much of it is disaffiliating congregations and unreported numbers, not empty pews. Third, the thesis is now testable. If Kelley was right, conviction should eventually show up in growth -- the Global Methodist Church, like every conservative successor, has to prove it isn't just the old UMC with stricter bylaws.
The United Methodists didn't lose six million members to the culture; they lost them to their own unbelief -- and when the faithful finally found the door, the institution locked it behind them.

---
**✅ Bring a valid photo ID**
Tennessee requires a photo ID with your name and picture. Accepted IDs include:
* Tennessee driver’s license
* U.S. passport
* Photo ID issued by the TN Department of Safety and Homeland Security
* Photo ID issued by the federal or Tennessee state government
* U.S. military photo ID
* Tennessee handgun carry permit with your photo

If your only ID is expired, an expired driver’s license or a photo ID issued by the TN Department of Safety, the state of Tennessee, or the federal government still works.
College student IDs, out of state IDs, city or county IDs, and tribal IDs are NOT acceptable.
If you show up without a valid photo ID, you’ll vote with a provisional ballot.
First-time voters and anyone with questions about exemptions can get the full details here:
[Voting FAQ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141618467/654162284/1030767096?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzEzNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMjk5YjI5Yy0zN2NhLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DLpBTXQvHJG5v1vWi-e_sAS8jRMfAltWU12yEO4Ueik=&emci=49efc6c7-82c9-f111-bf5b-000d3a4fbe83&emdi=d299b29c-37ca-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&ceid=6362892)
---
**✅Check who’s fighting for you**
Don’t forget to **FINISH YOUR BALLOT.** From Jerri Green for Governor and Marquita Bradshaw for U.S. Senate to your State House seat, Tennessee Democrats are running at every level to make life better and more affordable. Look up your candidates before you vote.
[See your candidate guide](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141618468/654162285/876156084?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzEzNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMjk5YjI5Yy0zN2NhLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DLpBTXQvHJG5v1vWi-e_sAS8jRMfAltWU12yEO4Ueik=&emci=49efc6c7-82c9-f111-bf5b-000d3a4fbe83&emdi=d299b29c-37ca-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&ceid=6362892)
---
**✅Save 833-DEM-VOTE**
If you’re turned away, face long lines, or run into any trouble at the polls, call our Voter Protection Hotline at 833-DEM-VOTE. You’ll be connected to trained election workers and volunteer attorneys who can help in real time.

name: Eric Pratt
subject: I’ll always wonder...
body:
If one more message could save MN-02, I had to send it.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/o5nO8cmVCeF?e=905d578f8e&c2id=16eb929e7cba591464984f29a5a61342)
| | | | | | ,

When this election is over and the final votes are counted in Minnesota’s 2nd Congressional District, I don’t want to look back and ask myself if we could have done more.If we come up short by a handful of votes in Dakota, Scott, Rice, Washington, or Le Sueur counties, I’ll always wonder if one more email or one more conversation with supporters like you would have made the difference.**So I’m writing to you directly today.**
---
| [HELP ME FLIP MN-02 RED >>](https://us.list-manage.com/OiIDRoSpHu4?e=905d578f8e&c2id=16eb929e7cba591464984f29a5a61342)
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |

Out-of-state special interest groups and D.C. mega-donors are dumping millions into our district to protect their radical agenda. They know that if Republicans flip**MN-02 RED** , their control over Washington is broken.**We don't have dark-money PACs funding our campaign. We have local families, small business owners, and grassroots patriots who care about the future of our communities.** Every dollar we raise today goes straight into keeping our door-knockers on the pavement, getting early ballot guides to local voters, and making sure our message cuts through the attack ads on TV.[**If you’re able to chip in $15 or $25 today, it will directly power our ground game in these final weeks.**](https://us.list-manage.com/ejn3BnJlz4f?e=905d578f8e&c2id=16eb929e7cba591464984f29a5a61342)

body:
#

Hola, Peter. It’s Ruben.
You might be wondering how this kid...
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct26.hW7fKt&refcode=em261017-1-90&t=1&akid=4223%2E734936%2E9Q1pN0)
...ended up here, on TV with Stephen Colbert, serving in the U.S. Senate, and squaring off against the worst president in American history.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct26.hW7fKt&refcode=em261017-1-90&t=2&akid=4223%2E734936%2E9Q1pN0)
Well, it started back in the apartment I shared with my mom and my sisters. It was tough. I was sleeping on the floor because that’s all we could afford.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct26.hW7fKt&refcode=em261017-1-90&t=3&akid=4223%2E734936%2E9Q1pN0)
I knew I had to do whatever it took to build a better life for us. I worked a bunch of jobs all through school to help make ends meet. Thanks to my family, my community, and a lot of hard work, I got into Harvard. But before I graduated, I enlisted in the Marines to serve the country that gave me so much.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct26.hW7fKt&refcode=em261017-1-90&t=4&akid=4223%2E734936%2E9Q1pN0)
I deployed to al Anbar, Iraq with my brothers in arms. We ended up the hardest hit Marine unit of the entire Iraq war, and I lost some of my best friends over there. After we came home I knew I had to do something to improve things for the guys I served with, for people who grew up like me. So, I ended up running for Congress — and I won.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct26.hW7fKt&refcode=em261017-1-90&t=5&akid=4223%2E734936%2E9Q1pN0)
Then, on January 6th, everything changed. It became clear to me that public service wasn’t just about improving the lives of the people in my community anymore — it was about defending our democracy, too.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct26.hW7fKt&refcode=em261017-1-90&t=6&akid=4223%2E734936%2E9Q1pN0)
So, I ran for Senate against one of Trump’s most loyal foot soldiers. And thanks to the support of millions of people, my friends, and my family, I won. Now, it’s my job to square off against Trump every day to defend our people and our Constitution.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct26.hW7fKt&refcode=em261017-1-90&t=7&akid=4223%2E734936%2E9Q1pN0)
When I was a Marine in Iraq, I never would’ve thought I’d have to fight to defend our democracy at home.

clean_body: Hola, Peter. It’s Ruben. You might be wondering how this kid... ...ended up here, on TV with Stephen Colbert, serving in the U.S. Senate, and squaring off against the worst president in American history. Well, it started back in the apartment I shared with my mom and my sisters. It was tough. I was sleeping on the floor because that’s all we could afford. I knew I had to do whatever it took to build a better life for us. I worked a bunch of jobs all through school to help make ends meet. Thanks to my family, my community, and a lot of hard work, I got into Harvard. But before I graduated, I enlisted in the Marines to serve the country that gave me so much. I deployed to al Anbar, Iraq with my brothers in arms. We ended up the hardest hit Marine unit of the entire Iraq war, and I lost some of my best friends over there. After we came home I knew I had to do something to improve things for the guys I served with, for people who grew up like me. So, I ended up running for Congress — and I won. Then, on January 6th, everything changed. It became clear to me that public service wasn’t just about improving the lives of the people in my community anymore — it was about defending our democracy, too. So, I ran for Senate against one of Trump’s most loyal foot soldiers. And thanks to the support of millions of people, my friends, and my family, I won. Now, it’s my job to square off against Trump every day to defend our people and our Constitution. When I was a Marine in Iraq, I never would’ve thought I’d have to fight to defend our democracy at home. There is a critical race in Michigan that Democrats are on the verge of losing. No, not the U.S. Senate race. The Michigan Supreme Court race.
Two Democrat backed judges are up for reelection on the state's highest court this year, Justices Megan Cavanagh and Noah Hood.
Right now, Michigan's Supreme Court has a liberal majority. This critical swing state court is a crucial firewall against Trump's attempt to seize control over how states run elections. Losing this court would be a devastating blow for Democrats.
If Hood and Cavanagh lose their seats, MAGA will have an opening to seize control of the court as soon as 2028, an absolutely devastating blow that would lead to MAGA election rigging in the state.

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: It is never too soon to do the right thing
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Thanksgiving is in 40 days. Families will come together, some from long distances.
#

Thanksgiving is in 40 days.
Families will come together, some from long distances. Little cousins will run around underfoot, aunts and uncles will help in the kitchen. The Macy's parade will be on TV, in the background. We will put everything else aside, for one day at least, and express our gratitude.
But four families in Oregon will have empty seats at their dinner tables this year. Two more will have loved ones recovering from their injuries, and the families of everyone connected to Thursday’s shooting at an elementary school in Bend will be asking themselves the same thing:
When is this going to change? How many more people will suffer through this? When will enough _**finally_** be enough?
Friend, my family has lived that. We have asked ourselves those very same questions. And after the horrific shooting at Sandy Hook, just before Christmas in 2012, we stopped waiting for answers.
We founded GIFFORDS to stop this, once and for all. We refuse to accept that this must continue, and we refuse to listen when others say it is "too soon" to act. We have decided to honor the people we've lost by taking action.
[**And today, I am asking you to make a donation to GIFFORDS PAC as we enter the final days of the most important election of our lifetime. If we do nothing, nothing will change. But we have an opportunity to stop this if enough people are moved to act. So, please.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q42026.PjNIJI&refcode=em261017-2-b&t=1&akid=11945%2E3935704%2E6YJO6e)

I will root out all fraud in our state social programs and prosecute fraudsters and accomplices to the fullest extent of the law. I will protect women and children from "transgender" predators in women's bathrooms and sports. I know this is the winning platform that all New Yorkers desperately need... but we've got to raise enough money to run this race and fight back against Hochul's attacks. **[Will you rush back your BLAKEMAN FOR GOVERNOR Emergency campaign contribution?](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwMzIsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA5X2e5w7_prdHEqODCzzzCuAmigz3s58gOSuKmvEw6y8INSwqtf5K080T6i3aPfzWbRHMBpriSXMH2m9HoUYOiJSGFMSMgmYMBCA-XMFkA)** With just weeks left until the election, we don't have a minute to waste. It's how she has lived her life, dedicated to her state. I'll be straight with you: Darline is behind financially, and the window to catch up is closing fast. Election Day is just 21 days away. TV time in South Carolina is being bought up right now, and every day Darline can't match her opponent on the air is a day voters only hear one side of the story. Darline is humble and poised. She's not someone who will beg for money. That's why I'm asking for her. Let me tell you about her Democrat opponent, Annie Andrews. She's as radical as they come. She thinks boys should be allowed to play in girls' sports. She's a paid gun-control advocate. She would cancel out every vote I cast in the United States Senate. If Annie Andrews wins, we can say goodbye to our Senate majority. And right now, she's outraising Darline by millions. Hollywood donors are lining up to help her defeat Darline. She's flooding the airwaves in South Carolina, trying to hide her radical agenda from voters. Fellow Patriot, Darline needs your help to set the record straight before ballots are cast. subject: We’ve fought Yass for years. Now take this fight to the Treasury
body:
We’re organizing against the voucher agenda threatening our schools, from Pennsylvania to Washington. | |
---
Peter, **Our children deserve schools where the heat works, classrooms have enough supplies, and a counselor has time to sit with a student who needs help.** We know what our schools need because our families depend on them every day. And we’re tired of watching politicians entertain another voucher scheme while those needs go unmet. **For years, OnePA members have organized to stop public taxpayer dollars from funding private school vouchers.** We’ve challenged Pennsylvania billionaire Jeffrey Yass’s attempts to dismantle public education. We’re fighting for the right of our communities to shape our children’s future. **We know how hard parents and educators work to hold our schools together. We show up at school board meetings, advocate for services, and demand the funding our children deserve.** Yass and his allies use their wealth to push an agenda that puts public dollars into private schools. We’re building the collective power to stop them. Now that fight is reaching Washington. The Trump administration’s federal voucher program would subsidize private school tuition through tax credits, reducing the revenue available for public education and other essential services.**The Treasury is proposing rules that would restrict participating states from demanding stronger safeguards. My name is Victor Marx -- a husband, father, Marine Corps veteran, former pastor, and founder of an international humanitarian organization that has carried out more than 150 high-risk rescue missions around the world.I've spent my life stepping into the chaos most people run from, fighting for those who can't fight for themselves. I never expected to run for Governor of Colorado... But people I respected deeply -- including Charlie and Erika Kirk -- believed in me and urged me to step forward because they saw what was happening here in our state.After Charlie was killed, Erika reminded me that he believed this was a fight I was meant to take on.They were right, and I am now fully committed to winning this fight. Because here's the truth most people outside our state don't realize: Colorado SHOULD still be a red state. Colorado was built on independence, limited government, faith, family, and the unshakeable belief in the Second Amendment. Those values run deep in our history and in our people.But over time, the political establishment and a flood of left-wing ideas have overpowered the very values that made Colorado strong. We've watched our state shift from red, to purple, to blue -- not because the people changed, but because leadership failed them.And that failure matters far beyond our borders. Colorado has become a testing ground for policies that spread nationwide -- soft-on-crime agendas, government overreach, attacks on faith, restrictions on constitutional freedoms. If we stop that tide here, we stop it from sweeping across America. That's why this race is so important. If Colorado flips back, the entire country will feel it. It will prove that conservative, constitutional values aren't fading -- they 're rising again! Our state and country has too many politicians , so instead, I'm asking you to stand with ME - a Marine, pastor, humanitarian, and Patriot - to ensure we have leaders who will fight to uphold and protect our values and freedoms. Voters in the RGV have the power to transform the political landscape of Texas.
#
We have major news, Peter.
Three of the most closely watched Democratic candidates in the country are joining Voto Latino on one stage in the Rio Grande Valley next week.
[](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20261017-1.VvMCqv&amount=3&refcode=em20261017-686&t=1&akid=686%2E1366028%2EiNu7hJ)
U.S. Senate nominee James Talarico, Gubernatorial nominee Gina Hinojosa, and congressional candidate Bobby Pulido are uniting in Weslaco for our massive Ready. Go. Vote. rally.
They’re coming together in South Texas for one simple reason. The path to winning the Texas governorship, taking the Senate, and flipping the House of Representatives runs straight through the Rio Grande Valley.
**The Valley is home to 665,575 eligible Latino voters.** That’s an _enormous_ voting bloc with the power to transform the political landscape of Texas and decide the balance of power in Washington.
Yet in 2024,**nearly 316,000 eligible Latino voters in the Valley sat out the election.**
**Closing that 316,000-voter gap means reaching every single family in the Valley with the resources, polling location details, and support they need to cast their ballots early.**

clean_body: Peter, I'm going to make a prediction... When the votes are counted this November, the radical left is going to be in a state of total shock. And the political establishment is going to spend weeks trying to explain what hit them. But that only happens if Republicans like you are on record before the Midterms. That is how consequential this moment is. But here is the part the pundits won't tell you. None of that happens automatically. The Democrats are at war with the American people -- open borders, defunding ICE, eliminating voter ID, putting men in women's sports. You name it, they are on the wrong side of it. And yet they are running the most radical, well-funded Senate candidates in states across this country who are counting on Republicans to stay home and let them walk right in. I will not let that happen. And I don't think you will either. I made you a prediction at the beginning of this email. I stand by every word of it. But that prediction is built on one assumption -- that Republicans like you are engaged and ready to fight. That is where your assessment comes in. Sincerely, Newt Gingrich Former Speaker of the House | Paid for by the NRSC. Not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. |

* * *
Ever since I got involved in politics, I've accurately predicted every national election cycle in America. And I'm here to do it once more.
Pollsters are infamous for missing the mark. But history shows we can still use their data to figure out where the midterms will land. I used this method in 2022 and 2024, and was proven right both times.
Despite popular belief, pollsters not directly on a campaign's payroll have a real incentive to be accurate. When they get it wrong, they lose credibility, and media outlets look elsewhere. That dynamic is a double-edged sword: accuracy might improve, but so does hedging. It's the reason races always seem to tighten and pollsters cluster around an average as Election Day nears.
Take a look at polling accuracy over the past two decades, though, and it tells an interesting story about GOP voters.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5179217f-70d4-4105-95e5-973b12a16415?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
On average, polling this century has been off by about 2.6%. This margin of error can often be explained by conservatives' reluctance to answer pollsters honestly, compared to liberals who tend to be more open about their politics.

_**(Piece continues):**_
Some well-meaning, though overly optimistic, conservatives have claimed this year's polling will be off by three times that amount. I think that's both inaccurate and unhelpful. I predict, once again, the polls will be off by 2-3%.
What does this mean?
## **Senate**
For the Senate, it means the following races that are currently leaning Democrat will actually flip to Republicans: Iowa, Maine, Alaska, and Minnesota. If Republicans do win those four seats, they will retain the Senate with 51 seats.
Now, it's important to bear in mind that this assumes Abdul El-Sayed wins his race in Michigan, and James Talarico wins his in Texas. Both are largely considered among the most radical politicians running in their party this cycle, and larger swings than 3% may happen as a result.
## **House**
In the House, Republicans face a much tougher battle. Current projections show Democrats holding a strong position, even before factoring in the tightest races. According to forecast models, while there are a number of true toss-up districts, Democrats are currently polling favorably enough to threaten the majority.
What Republicans do have going for them, however, is the redistricting battle. After a slew of legal challenges and map amendments over the last two years, Republicans have secured a net advantage in newly drawn districts. This structural edge alone could keep them from losing too much ground to the Democrats.
## **My prediction**
Republicans will not take the House, but they won't lose the Senate, either. When the dust settles, I believe Republicans will hold 51 to 52 Senate seats, keeping Trump safe from removal.
They won't have as much luck in the lower chamber. I predict Republicans won't pick up many toss-up districts, leaving them with roughly 200 to 210 total seats, while Democrats will control 225 to 235.
What can you expect for 2027 and 2028? A congressional deadlock. Trump will not be removed from office, but his legislative agenda won't be passed, either. We'll have to wait for 2029 to try to advance conservative legislation once again.

Pollsters are infamous for missing the mark. But history shows we can still use their data to figure out where the midterms will land. I used this method in 2022 and 2024, and was proven right both times. Despite popular belief, pollsters not directly on a campaign's payroll have a real incentive to be accurate. body:
[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/54940?refcode=em20261017-61917&t=1001&akid=61917%2E1407376%2EfE6dV0 ]Demand Justice PAC[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/54940?refcode=em20261017-61917&t=1002&akid=61917%2E1407376%2EfE6dV0 ]Demand Justice PAC

Ten federal
judges. One result: more power for corporations and the ultra-wealthy,
less for everyone else.

Together, they’re enabling the slide toward Oligarchy. Take a look:

#1: Judge Andrew Oldham: called our entire system of administrative law
“constitutionally suspect,” a view that threatens the EPA, OSHA, and the
CFPB.

#2: Chief Judge Reed O’Connor: ruled the entire Affordable Care Act
unconstitutional, a theory so extreme the Supreme Court reversed it 7-2.

#3: Chief Judge Amos Mazzant: struck down overtime pay for 4 million
workers and blocked a law targeting anonymous shell companies.

#4: Judge James C. Ho: reported 26 reimbursed trips, including a Cancun
junket paid for by the right-wing group behind overturning Roe v. Wade.

#5: Judge Don R. Willett: wants to revive the legal doctrine courts once
used to strike down minimum wage and child labor laws.

#6: Judge Edith H. Jones: argued for a theory that would have destroyed
the CFPB, the agency that has returned over $21 billion to consumers.

#7: Judge Victor Marrero: approved the T-Mobile/Sprint merger despite
objections from 14 state attorneys general. The combined company shed
roughly 14,000 jobs.

#8: Judge J. Campbell Barker: helped kill a rule that would have raised
franchise and contract workers’ pay by $1.06 billion a year.

#9: Judge Ada E. Brown: nullified the FTC’s non-compete ban, costing 30
million workers more than $400 billion in wages.

#10: Judge Sean D. Jordan: wiped out overtime protections for another 4
million workers, then killed a rule keeping medical debt off credit
reports.

Workers, consumers, and patients lose. Corporations and billionaires get
richer. Several of these judges have their lifestyles bankrolled by the
same conservative legal network shaping the bench, and we’re calling it
what it is: corruption.

Demand Justice PAC is fighting back: naming names, exposing the money and
influence behind these rulings, and fighting to restore independence to
our courts.

[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20261017.X6M4ZR&refcode=em20261017-61917&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=61917%2E1407376%2EfE6dV0 ]We can’t do it without grassroots supporters like you. Will you chip in
$5 today to help us fight the judges enabling the slide
toward Oligarchy?

— Demand Justice PAC

P.S. Read more about these judges in Demand Justice and Groundwork

body:

---
Peter,
There’s a lot of talk about a “blue wave” in November, but believe me: If we don’t get ALL of our voters out to vote, then you can kiss that wave goodbye in North Carolina.
The North Carolina Democratic Party is doing the work to turn out voters across the state, not just for this race, but for every race on the ballot so that come November 4th, we can say that we elected new justices to the courts, representatives to Congress, and state legislators to the General Assembly. [**_If you’re all in to help flip North Carolina, split a donation between our campaign and the North Carolina Democratic Party today._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/19914?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk1691&amount=5&t=8&akid=4617%2E124072%2EV0zV_h)
North Carolina is one of the most closely watched states in the country. Races are tightening and in some districts, a few hundred votes could decide who represents us in Raleigh and Washington.
Winning in North Carolina means winning up and down the ballot, from the state house to the state Supreme Court to my race for U.S. Senate. The NCDP is organizing for every one of those races, all across the state.
It takes an enormous amount of effort to make sure voters across North Carolina know their voting options, have a plan to vote and feel equipped at the ballot box. That means volunteers knocking on doors, organizers building relationships in communities from the mountains to the coast and supporting every Democratic candidate on the ballot.
**None of it happens without a well-resourced and well-equipped North Carolina Democratic Party, so we need your support today.**
A Democratic North Carolina means a state government that fights for the hardworking people who have been struggling to make ends meet. It means that there are people in office fighting for better public schools and affordable health care.
That future depends on what happens in the next few weeks. And it depends on a well-resourced NCDP that is properly equipped to continue reaching voters all across the state.
[**_If you care about turning North Carolina blue, please chip in a donation split between our campaign and the NCDP today._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/19914?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk1691&amount=5&t=9&akid=4617%2E124072%2EV0zV_h)
| | [DONATE](https://act.roycooper.com/go/19915?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk1691&amount=5&t=10&akid=4617%2E124072%2EV0zV_h)
---
Every dollar goes towards reaching voters in the final stretch, and every vote matters.
I’m grateful I can count on people like you.

Roy Cooper
| |

Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

Hi Peter, We talk a lot about the impacts of abortion bans and the fight over mifepristone, and those battles are real and ongoing. But I want to make sure you know about some of the other ways this administration is attacking reproductive healthcare right now, because the hits are coming from every direction at once.
1. **RFK Jr. is blocking teen pregnancy prevention funding.** Congress passed $100 million for these programs, but less than 1% of that money has been spent this past fiscal year. HHS is obligated to spend that money, as directed by Congress – it’s not optional.

As an OB-GYN, I’m extremely concerned about what this means for young people, their safety, their health, and their well-being. I’m leading more than 90 House and Senate Democrats in demanding that RFK Jr. release this funding immediately. We will not let this administration put teenagers’ lives at risk to advance their dangerous agenda.

2. **There’s an estrogen patch shortage here in the U.S. and no plan to fix it.** Estrogen patches help millions of women manage menopause symptoms, and for many of them, these patches are life-changing. It is unacceptable that the FDA has no plan to address this shortage, so the House Democratic Women’s Caucus is demanding answers from RFK Jr. immediately.

3. **Trump’s FDA pick won’t say that birth control _isn’t_ abortion.** His nominee to lead the FDA, Heidi Overton, holds extreme anti-science views on vaccines and reproductive health. During her confirmation hearing, Senator Patty Murray asked her directly whether she agrees with the Trump administration falsely calling an IUD an abortifacient, and she wouldn’t answer.

Trump wants to hand control over Americans’ access to birth control, vaccine regulations, food safety, and prescription drug supply to someone who refuses to acknowledge that birth control is not abortion. She is completely unfit for the role, and the Senate must reject her nomination.

Every one of these attacks is part of a coordinated effort to restrict access to reproductive healthcare for every American, and they will continue unless we flip the House and put real guardrails on this administration.

clean_body: These aren’t the fights you usually hear about – but they’re just as dangerous| | | | = Hi Peter, We talk a lot about the impacts of abortion bans and the fight over mifepristone, and those battles are real and ongoing. But I want to make sure you know about some of the other ways this administration is attacking reproductive healthcare right now, because the hits are coming from every direction at once. 1. RFK Jr. is blocking teen pregnancy prevention funding. Congress passed $100 million for these programs, but less than 1% of that money has been spent this past fiscal year. HHS is obligated to spend that money, as directed by Congress – it’s not optional. As an OB-GYN, I’m extremely concerned about what this means for young people, their safety, their health, and their well-being. I’m leading more than 90 House and Senate Democrats in demanding that RFK Jr. release this funding immediately. We will not let this administration put teenagers’ lives at risk to advance their dangerous agenda. 2. There’s an estrogen patch shortage here in the U.S. and no plan to fix it. Estrogen patches help millions of women manage menopause symptoms, and for many of them, these patches are life-changing. It is unacceptable that the FDA has no plan to address this shortage, so the House Democratic Women’s Caucus is demanding answers from RFK Jr. immediately. 3. Trump’s FDA pick won’t say that birth control isn’t abortion. His nominee to lead the FDA, Heidi Overton, holds extreme anti-science views on vaccines and reproductive health. During her confirmation hearing, Senator Patty Murray asked her directly whether she agrees with the Trump administration falsely calling an IUD an abortifacient, and she wouldn’t answer. Trump wants to hand control over Americans’ access to birth control, vaccine regulations, food safety, and prescription drug supply to someone who refuses to acknowledge that birth control is not abortion. She is completely unfit for the role, and the Senate must reject her nomination. Every one of these attacks is part of a coordinated effort to restrict access to reproductive healthcare for every American, and they will continue unless we flip the House and put real guardrails on this administration. = If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately. | | | = | | = | | | = | | = | | | = | | | I’m not going to stop fighting – not on teen pregnancy prevention, not on menopause care, not on birth control – not on any of it. Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

| | We launched our campaign for Congress with a belief that our community deserves better and a scrappiness that’s unique to Michigan’s 10th. I knew this journey would require sacrifice, and I also knew it would come with incredible moments. I want to share my favorite part of this experience with you:
---
It’s the conversations that stay with you.
Sometimes those conversations are hard. Seniors worried about rising grocery costs and threats to Social Security. Working parents doing everything they can to stay afloat while giving their kids the best life possible. A neighbor quietly sharing concerns about her mother’s recent cancer diagnosis.
Sometimes those conversations are full of joy: “I’ve never actually had a politician knock on my door before!” “My daughter is starting at Michigan in the fall!” “DEEETROIT BASKETBALL!”
These moments are my favorite part of this race because they remind me why this campaign matters. At the end of the day, people want to know that someone in Washington is listening and willing to fight for them. These conversations also remind me that even in difficult times, we can still build something better together for our families, our communities, and our future.
[**_It takes $250 a day to keep our door-to-door campaign running. If the first 20 people who read this email split a $25 contribution between our campaign and Jeremy Moss, we can make sure we fill up our staff’s gas tanks to travel to events and outfit them with megaphones and clipboards. clean_body: One of them decides the House. We just won the primary in it. | | | | | = | | We launched our campaign for Congress with a belief that our community deserves better and a scrappiness that’s unique to Michigan’s 10th. I knew this journey would require sacrifice, and I also knew it would come with incredible moments. I want to share my favorite part of this experience with you: It’s the conversations that stay with you. Sometimes those conversations are hard. Seniors worried about rising grocery costs and threats to Social Security. Working parents doing everything they can to stay afloat while giving their kids the best life possible. A neighbor quietly sharing concerns about her mother’s recent cancer diagnosis. Sometimes those conversations are full of joy: “I’ve never actually had a politician knock on my door before!” “My daughter is starting at Michigan in the fall!” “DEEETROIT BASKETBALL!” These moments are my favorite part of this race because they remind me why this campaign matters. At the end of the day, people want to know that someone in Washington is listening and willing to fight for them. These conversations also remind me that even in difficult times, we can still build something better together for our families, our communities, and our future. = | | | | | = | | This past year has changed me, and I feel grateful for every person who has shown up, shared their story, volunteered, donated, or believed in what we’re building together. And the best part is that we’re just getting started. Together, we’re going to fight to lower costs, protect working families, defend our democracy, and deliver the leadership this district deserves. = | | | | | | = | | | = | | | = | | | = | | | | = | | | | We can make a real difference, Christina | | | | | | = | | | | | | Paid for by Jeremy Moss for Congress | | Jeremy Moss for Congress 2211 S Telegraph Rd PO Box 7023 Bloomfield Hills, MI 48302 United States | | | | | | | | | | = | | | = | | This message was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. | |

| | | | | On the U.S. government's books, gold is worth $42.22 an ounce.

That price was set in 1973.

Today, gold trades around $4,500.

That's a 113-to-1 gap between what the Treasury _says_ its gold is worth... and what it's actually worth.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has told us what he wants to do about it.

On the record, he said he intends to _"monetize the asset side of the balance sheet."_

That's not a throwaway line. It's a signal.

Because the easiest way to monetize that side of the ledger is to do one thing: Revalue the gold.

With a single decision, the government could mark up its reserves by more than $1 trillion overnight.

After 20 years studying gold and debt cycles, [I can tell you what that kind of move really means.](https://links.dpt.deepregimetrends.com/u/click?_t=4a25883d9bf54436b571b8aa9717dcca&_m=d9f86d0edf624161964c53d379e6354e&_e=vhTH3hqZK-4EQsx87OrlkgEuH_vHwo5rgbI9SAExvBBbZ5e9AtfYbLW4lA1sV24t6otRDqZmmbpChERpsq-C6o1Nwu2SFkiKHu8xkLV2oAkvhcR8urNWk-fOvRf5WetALcd4i7HpFZigIoi44WNU-eiypZ1ttfC_P34kxu58XGiK5JzM4lWiPtSDQsjPWyvwDOP4oVs3CmgY5bZoTSicCPsq0H-NrE07-otDo_a270f1G3i6NqxpArhpzroNz4ivPf6lrpIJYwkC8DKMNVryljvsV8_1yDpGKv1VBlhHc_e3QMly9yVEo3deYCugUkLqS9NGSFID87yGcAiK6jKHxWXs_4rBUxzRRRj_J3z8SLLNAu_9HR6kOdbsK88gz0n5s88aPPvNza8lHRNW4X28N13p5TNC9kijGMNgg-AT7aqg9a87DZGj8cFxA3EyRM9k_FpjPDk2mgGhVJD_GWpblZXVbEmmWdLT9agfzKIJBYvPbLdeHO4ZKosg5K2KLml_0xBUaGY01lVCAPh_xBLwQ8SiV1j1Xir6-yZcV9bU8Rk%3D)

A government doesn't revalue its gold when things are fine.

It does it when the _other_ side of the balance sheet — the debt side — is in trouble. It's what you do when you need to signal strength to the world because the old source of strength is failing.

And every other signal is already flashing:

* Oil is settling in yuan through the Iranian toll booth in Hormuz.
* The petrodollar arrangement was cracking even before the war.
* Foreign demand for Treasuries is fading.

When a shift like this comes, it doesn't arrive gradually.

And when the government revalues gold to save itself, [that's the moment you cannot own enough of it.](https://links.dpt.deepregimetrends.com/u/click?_t=4a25883d9bf54436b571b8aa9717dcca&_m=d9f86d0edf624161964c53d379e6354e&_e=vhTH3hqZK-4EQsx87OrlkgEuH_vHwo5rgbI9SAExvBBbZ5e9AtfYbLW4lA1sV24t6otRDqZmmbpChERpsq-C6o1Nwu2SFkiKHu8xkLV2oAkvhcR8urNWk-fOvRf5WetALcd4i7HpFZigIoi44WNU-eiypZ1ttfC_P34kxu58XGhI9Ost8qcHE1JELklxObmSU-8MP8zOOyWPMKb7Bt4FQ5ISmp_6_aTygCwJQCQr7t9bqdmKN-xBrEMqGzdtBd6veF3759oJ1YX0zD2Xv81jbyTUX_I9R6JiafbaDsz1OxdPTP0RzJi4oqhbGRvEZNIdbV4JjeX9Wt9yhoIrNhFJSBTSVUbkO0An9Xe-H2Sw6nCamKULgkVH6F0-G-gT8teuee6prcT2iVG9kD_KEO2CSjbI-XIe_oxRgM705FTDR05zfuEE-cG8z_JB8zAMh9vtUPx_D49Ltyo8kYuMWVAjHeLRX8YNq4zO2yIShkYcewn6U-aN8w_g3__YZx3i54WkewDAC7pb4Gv8SLggPYs9N8GY-XGofKbt7e1GZIONGRY%3D)

Case File No DRT-ED-42 · Special File · The $42 Line
On Washington’s Books, Gold Is Still Worth $42 an Ounce. One Accounting Change Could Add About $1 Trillion Overnight.
The U.S. holds about 261 million ounces of gold, valued on paper at $42.22 an ounce, a price set in the 1970s. At today’s roughly $4,170, that gold is worth about $1.1 trillion. The Treasury Secretary has talked about “monetizing” the asset side of the balance sheet. Investors are starting to connect the dots.
Threat level 4/5 — Elevated
| | | | | | | | |
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
|
---
Most Americans assume the government values its gold at the market price. It doesn’t. By law, Washington still carries its gold at $42.22 an ounce, a number set more than 50 years ago. The gap between that and the real price has never been bigger.
The evidence board
| | The Numbers
---|---
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit A — the official price.** The statutory value of U.S. gold has been $42.22 an ounce since 1973. At that price, America’s roughly 261 million ounces are carried at about $11 billion.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit B — the market price.** Gold traded around $4,168 an ounce on October 16. At that price, the same gold is worth roughly $1.08 trillion.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit C — the signal.** In February 2025, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the administration would “monetize the asset side of the U.S. balance sheet.”
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit D — the pressure.** U.S. public debt hit a record of about $40.3 trillion on October 8.
| OUR THEORY
---
Revaluing the gold wouldn’t require buying a single ounce. It would simply mark an existing asset up to market value, creating roughly $1 trillion on paper. Governments don’t usually reach for moves like that when everything is fine. They do it when the other side of the ledger, the debt side, is under strain. And if it happens, it would be a public signal that gold is central to the system again.
Decoder
| | The Phrase to Watch
---|---
| | “Monetize the asset side of the U.S. balance sheet.”— Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, February 2025

The Most Valuable Part of Your iPhone May Have Been Designed in an Ordinary Office Park in Texas.
Texas has put nearly $700 million into chips. Samsung is building Tesla’s AI chip just outside Austin. And one of the world’s most important chip designers just expanded its biggest U.S. site there. The factories get the headlines. The designers often get the money.

name: NEGOP
subject: Reminder: 🚨 Your Weekly Update From The NEGOP
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Nebraska Republican Party 1610 N St
body:
News, events, and action items to keep Nebraska red and growing strong.
| | | | |
---
| Letter from the Chair
---
| Friends,
Let's be blunt. The Democrats can't win Nebraska off their platform. So they're betting you won't show up.
That's the whole plan. Out-of-state money for Denise Powell in Omaha. A Democrat Party backing Dan Osborn instead of running its own nominee. Paid organizers knocking doors in your neighborhood right now. All of it built on one assumption: that Nebraska Republicans are too comfortable to vote.
And if they're right, we pay for it. Lose the Senate seat, and Chuck Schumer is one step closer to running the U.S. Senate again. Lose two seats in the Legislature, and property tax relief dies in a filibuster. Lose the State Board of Education, and the people deciding what your kids learn won't share your values. Lose the races at the bottom of the ballot, and your utility bill gets set by people who never answer to you.
Remember, 312 votes gave Washington Obamacare. Don't let a few hundred Nebraskans who "meant to vote" hand our state to the Left.
So let's make a plan, and let's make it today.
Start by making sure you're registered at ne.gov/go/votercheck. It takes thirty seconds. If you've moved, you still have until October 23 to register in person at your county election office.
Then decide when you're voting, and don't say "Election Day." In-person early voting is open right now at your county election office through November 2. Walk in, vote, and be done with it. If you'd rather vote by mail, get your request in by October 23 and drop that ballot off yourself instead of trusting it to the mail at the last minute.
Bring your photo ID. We fought hard for voter ID in this state. Use it.
And when you get your ballot, vote the whole thing, top to bottom. The Left shows up for every race on that ballot, from Senate to the power board. So should we.
Last thing. Don't go alone. Bring your spouse, your neighbor, and that coworker who complains about property taxes every Monday but hasn't voted since 2020. Don't just remind them. Bring them.
The other side has a plan. Now you do too.
Together we win!

clean_body: News, events, and action items to keep Nebraska red and growing strong. | | | | | | Letter from the Chair | Friends, Let's be blunt. The Democrats can't win Nebraska off their platform. So they're betting you won't show up. That's the whole plan. Out-of-state money for Denise Powell in Omaha. A Democrat Party backing Dan Osborn instead of running its own nominee. Paid organizers knocking doors in your neighborhood right now. All of it built on one assumption: that Nebraska Republicans are too comfortable to vote. And if they're right, we pay for it. Lose the Senate seat, and Chuck Schumer is one step closer to running the U.S. Senate again. Lose two seats in the Legislature, and property tax relief dies in a filibuster. Lose the State Board of Education, and the people deciding what your kids learn won't share your values. Lose the races at the bottom of the ballot, and your utility bill gets set by people who never answer to you. Remember, 312 votes gave Washington Obamacare. Don't let a few hundred Nebraskans who "meant to vote" hand our state to the Left. So let's make a plan, and let's make it today. Start by making sure you're registered at ne.gov/go/votercheck. It takes thirty seconds. If you've moved, you still have until October 23 to register in person at your county election office. Then decide when you're voting, and don't say "Election Day." In-person early voting is open right now at your county election office through November 2. Walk in, vote, and be done with it. If you'd rather vote by mail, get your request in by October 23 and drop that ballot off yourself instead of trusting it to the mail at the last minute. Bring your photo ID. We fought hard for voter ID in this state. Use it. And when you get your ballot, vote the whole thing, top to bottom. The Left shows up for every race on that ballot, from Senate to the power board. Folks, as I write this, North Carolinians are already voting.
If you've been waiting for the most impactful moment to support my campaign, today __ is the day.**[We need to continue meeting our fundraising goals to reach more voters, so please: Will you chip in right now?](https://substack.com/redirect/34f14037-032a-4fb3-b5da-dd0eb023ed10?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/34f14037-032a-4fb3-b5da-dd0eb023ed10?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
It's been nearly 20 years since we sent a Democrat to the U.S. Senate from NC. _That 's a long time and it just shows how hard flipping this seat is going to be._
Experts say our campaign is the best chance to change that. Poll after poll shows us surging ahead, thanks to the support of people like you. We're on the verge of defeating my MAGA opponent, flipping this seat and, with it, the Senate.
However, we can't take our foot off the gas. I'm still up against Trump's handpicked candidate - a guy who used to chair the national Republican Party. I'm still being attacked with lies and character smears. I'm still fighting back against my opponent's constant attacks.
The only way I can cross the finish line on November 3rd and win is with your critical grassroots support. We must reach every last voter in every corner of North Carolina before it's too late.
**[Please, can I count on you to chip in $5 today to help us ramp up our voter outreach, flip North Carolina blue and take back the Senate for Democrats?](https://substack.com/redirect/34f14037-032a-4fb3-b5da-dd0eb023ed10?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/34f14037-032a-4fb3-b5da-dd0eb023ed10?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thanks for giving what you can today. Your support means a lot to me.
Roy Cooper

body:
[ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
Derek, I get asked
a version of this question often: “Aren’t you going to win anyway?”

I understand why people ask it. I also know exactly what happens to a
campaign where enough people decide the answer is unanimously yes.

So here’s the honest version,
Derek: Nobody who’s run statewide
in Pennsylvania trusts an October number. Races here have often come down
to a point or two in either direction.

What decides the outcome isn’t polling — it’s how many people did
something these last three weeks instead of assuming it was settled. And
every assumption is a door we don’t knock.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/18191?t=1001&akid=658%2E245147%2EWOe7bJ ]So let me ask you plainly: Will you chip in
$15 today
and be one of the thousands of folks we need to step up?

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/18191?t=1002&akid=658%2E245147%2EWOe7bJ ]Donate →

Here’s what happens if we just assume we can coast into Election Day.
Donations don’t get made. A volunteer shift doesn’t get filled. A neighbor
doesn’t get asked to make a plan to vote – all because something felt
‘safe’ in the middle of October.

And there’s a real clock on this one. Our filing deadline is Monday night,
so what we raise between now and then will be made public.

And the people who’ll read that report most closely aren’t assuming
anything. The outside groups writing massive checks to my far-right
opponent are spending like this race is winnable, because they believe it
is. The only open question is whether the people who want to help keep
Pennsylvania moving forward are treating it as seriously as they are.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/18191?t=1003&akid=658%2E245147%2EWOe7bJ ]So please,
Derek: If you’ve been telling
yourself this one’s handled, let this be the email that changes your mind.
Chip in
$15 today
— because the fastest way to lose a race like this is for a few hundred
thousand people to decide it’s already won, and Donald Trump’s allies are
counting on exactly that.

Hope to see you on Saturday!

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: My grandmother’s tortilla con aguacate
body:
Mine depends on where I am in Texas, and so do the fights we’re facing.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
Earlier this year, a podcast host asked me my favorite taco order. My honest answer: it depends on where I am.
In Central Texas, it’s potato and egg. In the Rio Grande Valley, I’m getting barbacoa. In El Paso, it’s something with chile colorado. And at home, it’s a simple tortilla con aguacate, because it takes me back to my grandmother’s kitchen.
**Texas is a big, diverse state, and just like our taco orders, the challenges we face change from region to region.**
In rural Texas, communities are fighting back against data center giants. In Corpus Christi, families spent months not knowing whether they’d run out of water. And out west along the border, activists have come together to protect Big Bend from destruction.
**_But no matter where we live, we’re fighting for the same thing: a fair shot at the American dream._** For me, that means well-funded neighborhood public schools, access to healthcare, and a chance to buy a home and maybe take a vacation every now and then. Under Greg Abbott, that dream is slipping out of reach for too many Texans.
For 30 years, Abbott has put his donors ahead of hardworking Texans to stay in power. This election is our chance to end his political career.
It won’t be easy. Early voting starts in just two days, and November 3rd will be here before we know it. This race is neck and neck, and we wouldn’t have this kind of momentum without supporters like you.
**[Will you make your first contribution of $15 today to keep our ads on the air and our volunteers knocking doors right up until the polls close?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20261017_4_taco.JIBV_m&refcode=em20261017-2452&t=1&akid=2452%2E299639%2EfjW1Kl)**
[Donate »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20261017_4_taco.JIBV_m&refcode=em20261017-2452&t=20&akid=2452%2E299639%2EfjW1Kl)
Whatever your taco order, I’m running to be a governor for all of Texas.
Thank you,
Gina

* Farmworkers are being detained on their way to work,
* Parents are keeping children home from school,
* Businesses are experiencing worker absences,
* And some residents are avoiding public spaces altogether.

Instead of defending his constituents against the abuses of ICE, Congressman David Valadao said in last week’s debate, “It is what it is.” His opponent, WFP champion Randy Villegas, is ready to fight for everyone in this district, create pathways to citizenship, end for-profit immigration detention, and hold these ICE agents accountable for terrorizing our communities. clean_body: | | | Peter, Since ICE agents have ramped up operations throughout California’s Central Valley, people in the community are living in fear. Farmworkers are being detained on their way to work, Parents are keeping children home from school, Businesses are experiencing worker absences, And some residents are avoiding public spaces altogether. Instead of defending his constituents against the abuses of ICE, Congressman David Valadao said in last week’s debate, “It is what it is.” His opponent, WFP champion Randy Villegas, is ready to fight for everyone in this district, create pathways to citizenship, end for-profit immigration detention, and hold these ICE agents accountable for terrorizing our communities. While David Valadao lies that only people with a criminal record are being targeted, reports from the ground are much different. A representative from the United Farm Workers says that “anybody that looks Brown and working-class right now is being stopped,” and immigration sweeps are taking place outside of Latino grocery stores, pharmacies, community hospitals, and even domestic violence shelters across the district. Voters need a representative who will fight to end these raids — not a coward like David Valadao, who voted in 2025 to send more than $170 billion to immigration enforcement with no accountability whatsoever. While ICE sweeps and detainments tear families apart, these Valadao-backed raids have another consequence: With Election Day just weeks away, Latino residents of all immigration statuses are avoiding leaving their homes for fear of being harassed and targeted, decreasing voter turnout and potentially handing Valadao a win in this 73% Latino swing district.
