Friends,
We recently went live with a new ad -- have you seen it yet? If not, I'm excited for you to take a look:
[](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/dd41f50f-6270-494a-91db-2c19b1a18d6c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Watch the Ad](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/dd41f50f-6270-494a-91db-2c19b1a18d6c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**After listening to thousands of Kansans about the challenges they 're facing, it's clear Kansans are ready for change and to elect a new leader in Washington.**
I'm here to solve the real issues that are plaguing the people of Kansas. I'm here to be a champion for folks -- to listen to them, to open my heart to them and to do everything in my power to make their lives better.
But with less than three weeks until Election Day, polls show this race is neck and neck. That's why we need this ad to run in living rooms across Kansas -- during the news, during the games and in between the shows Kansans are watching.
With the top GOP super PAC launching a massive ad buy to turn voters against me, getting this ad in front of every Kansan matters more than ever. Election Day is November 3, and early voting has already started. **That 's why we need to keep this ad running and make sure that Kansans across the state know I can solve the issues that are hurting them most.**
But it's not enough to get this ad on TV a handful of times. This close to the election, political ads are running non-stop. In fact, just a few days ago, 34 political ads ran between 5 and 7 a.m. on one NBC affiliate alone. We have to make sure our message doesn't get drowned out, which means we need to get this ad on the air as frequently as possible -- on TV and digital platforms as well -- to make sure voters see it.
That's not the only reason we need to get as much airtime as possible. You probably already know the NYT listed this as one of the most competitive Senate races in the country. Multiple election forecasters -- from Nate Silver to the Cook Political Report to Steve Kornacki -- are calling this race a toss-up. And Roll Call officially named Roger Marshall one of the most vulnerable senators in the country.
But the closer we get to Election Day, the tighter this race gets. And the more Sen. Marshall's allies play attack ads against me, the more our razor-thin lead shrinks. **We have to fight back, and we have to do it now.**
TV time doesn't come cheap, especially during prime time. My team and I believe it's worth it, though, because it's a chance for thousands of Kansans to meet me in their living room. Not only that: the data shows TV ads can really help. That's why we're committed to doing this.
**But we can 't do it alone. I'm counting on a surge of grassroots support from people like you to help me keep this ad on the air right up to Election Day. [Please, if you're able, will you chip in whatever you can today and help us reach folks in every corner of Kansas?](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4b4c23ca-8323-4f9e-88d9-d2312838ee01?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Donate](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4b4c23ca-8323-4f9e-88d9-d2312838ee01?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
At this critical moment, every dollar really does make a difference.
Thank you for all you do,
Adam Hamilton

body:
Not what I spent my time doing

|
Peter,
I’ll be honest with you... I’m not great at asking for money. It’s the part of this job I hate the most.
I didn’t spend my twenties learning how to fundraise to run for office. I spent them flying H-46 helicopters for the Navy and deploying to the Persian Gulf.
And when I came home, I didn’t become a lobbyist who took clients out to expensive dinners. I used my GI Bill to become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. My "networking" was holding the hands of our seniors and listening to their stories, not cutting backroom deals.
That’s really who I am...a Helicopter Pilot...a Nurse Practitioner... and a Mom trying to raise four happy and healthy kids in a world that feels like it’s going in the wrong direction most days.
[I didn't run for Congress for the title. I ran because I looked at the country my children were inheriting, and I felt sick to my stomach. I couldn't just sit there.](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmcmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW10cG9zaXRpb249MyZleF90aWQ9MjAyNjEwMTdfVVgtSE4uMTEwMTE3X3QyMDYyMzYxLTIwNjgmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjYxMDE3X1VYLUhOLjExMDExN190MjA2MjM2MS0yMDY4In0/XWd_ogERII0AwcZ7sPWPtw)
But here is the hard truth: fighting the radical Left and standing up for our values is incredibly expensive. I don’t have a massive machine behind me. I don’t have someone who can write blank checks on a whim.
[I just have normal folks like you.](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmcmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW10cG9zaXRpb249MyZleF90aWQ9MjAyNjEwMTdfVVgtSE4uMTEwMTE3X3QyMDYyMzYxLTIwNjgmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjYxMDE3X1VYLUhOLjExMDExN190MjA2MjM2MS0yMDY4In0/-yiXDNT39yj5lBZsASHU1Q)
I know things are tight right now. I see it at the grocery store just like you do. But if you can spare even $5 to help keep a Navy Vet and a Nurse Practitioner in this fight, it would mean the world to me.

clean_body: A state built on faith, family, freedom, and the Second Amendment is being tested -- and its future will shape the country. | | | | | Friend, | | If this is the first time you're hearing from me, let me introduce myself. My name is Victor Marx -- a husband, father, Marine Corps veteran, former pastor, and founder of an international humanitarian organization that has carried out more than 150 high-risk rescue missions around the world.I've spent my life stepping into the chaos most people run from, fighting for those who can't fight for themselves. I never expected to run for Governor of Colorado... But people I respected deeply -- including Charlie and Erika Kirk -- believed in me and urged me to step forward because they saw what was happening here in our state.After Charlie was killed, Erika reminded me that he believed this was a fight I was meant to take on.They were right, and I am now fully committed to winning this fight. Because here's the truth most people outside our state don't realize: Colorado SHOULD still be a red state. Colorado was built on independence, limited government, faith, family, and the unshakeable belief in the Second Amendment. Those values run deep in our history and in our people.But over time, the political establishment and a flood of left-wing ideas have overpowered the very values that made Colorado strong. We've watched our state shift from red, to purple, to blue -- not because the people changed, but because leadership failed them.And that failure matters far beyond our borders. Colorado has become a testing ground for policies that spread nationwide -- soft-on-crime agendas, government overreach, attacks on faith, restrictions on constitutional freedoms. If we stop that tide here, we stop it from sweeping across America. That's why this race is so important. If Colorado flips back, the entire country will feel it. It will prove that conservative, constitutional values aren't fading -- they 're rising again! Our state and country has too many politicians , so instead, I'm asking you to stand with ME - a Marine, pastor, humanitarian, and Patriot - to ensure we have leaders who will fight to uphold and protect our values and freedoms. This is our chance to send that message. This is our chance to restore a state that should never have been lost.And this is the moment every patriot -- in Colorado and across America -- should care about. If you're just learning about me today, I hope it's the beginning of something bigger. Because this movement isn't powered by mega-donors or coastal elites -- Thank you for standing with me! For Colorado. For America. Victor Marx Conservative for Governor of Colorado | | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- | | PAID FOR BY VICTOR MARX FOR GOVERNOR Registered Agent: Gregory Carlson | | P.O. **We won 't be that team.**

But we're FAR from throwing in the towel.
Now that we're in the home stretch, your direct support to me and this movement becomes even more important.
Truth be told, it'd be a disaster if we lost you, Fellow American.

name: Jace Yarbrough
subject: Do you trust your neighbors?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Yarbrough for Congress
body:
It is heartbreaking

It is heartbreaking
| Do you trust your neighbors, Peter?This would've been an easy question for me back when I knew my neighbors and could count on them. I would always see most of my neighbors at church, and there was a collective will among us to do something for our people and community.We used to belong to a community where everyone looked out for each other, and that's what made America great in the first place.It is heartbreaking to tell you that this is all going away.As our communities have been invaded by people from the Third World, we've lost our sense of who we are. They came here and took advantage of us.[How can you trust your neighbors when all they do is take from you while sharing none of your values, heritage, or faith?](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.)This is outrageous, and the fact that the Federal Government knowingly let this happen to your community and our society is beyond shameful.
---
| [STOP THE INVASION](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.)
---
Our country and culture can never be strong unless we bring back trust in our communities.This is the starting point, and we can accept nothing less.[That's why I'm starting the fight in Texas.](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.)What we stand for in Texas and our country, cannot be wiped away by the Third World.And the DC Swamp that is enabling this must be destroyed immediately.
---
| [STOP THE DC SWAMP](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.)
---
[That is why I am humbly asking for your support today. We have to fight back now, or we LOSE everything. We cannot let this madness continue, and I would be forever grateful if you lend your hand today to fight for our communities.](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.-eEZQD2gaYakXQzg)Thank you for putting your trust in me, a fellow American. I will never take your support for granted.
---

---
| [FIGHT WITH JACE!](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.)
---
God Bless You, and God Bless America,
---

name: Kailee, me (2)
subject: re: did you get this message?
body:
Peter, I saved your spot

| | | | |
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |
Peter, did you get my email the other day?
I looked over our Victory Captain list this morning, and I didn't see your name yet.
I know how busy life gets, so I wanted to make sure my invitation didn't slip past you.
With less than 20 days to go, there's no time to waste. The people who step up now will decide how this race ends. _**And I want you in that group.**_
Will you take ten seconds right now to accept your Victory Captain role?
[**ACCEPT MY VICTORY CAPTAIN ROLE >>**](https://us.list-manage.com/19ep3EiatC2?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843)
Saying yes means you're ready to stand with me through Election Day, helping your friends and neighbors get to the polls and making sure Central New York hears our message loud and clear.
**I'd be honored to add your name today, Peter.**
Kailee
\-------------------- FORWARDED MESSAGE --------------------To: dpwillis67@gmail.comFrom: Kailee

---
| |
Peter,
We are now 21 days away from Election Day.
When I started this campaign, I said it would be built from the ground up by the people of Central New York. You've been part of that from the start, and I'm grateful.
**But these final weeks are when races like ours are won or lost.**
Every conversation with a neighbor, every reminder to a friend, and every yard sign in a front lawn matters more now than at any point in this campaign.
That is why I'm asking you to become an official VICTORY CAPTAIN for Kailee Buller for Congress.
[**YES, I'LL BE A VICTORY CAPTAIN >>**](https://us.list-manage.com/u1wBuMjp6u0?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843)
Here's what being a Victory Captain means...
Victory Captains are the people I'll count on most in the home stretch. You'll be the first to hear our closing plan, the first to get our final campaign updates, and the person your friends and family turn to when they want to know what's really at stake in this race.
_**We'll be counting on you to help make sure the people in your life have a plan to vote, to let us know who could use a yard sign, and to keep us in touch with what's happening in your corner of NY-22.**_
_**You'll be the reason voters who might have stayed home show up instead.**_
I'm running to lower costs, protect our communities, defend our farmers and small businesses, and make Central New York a place where our kids can build their futures. And I need people like you standing with me now, more than ever.
[ _So, Peter, will you be there?_](https://us.list-manage.com/dN2B_9CLYGp?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843)
---
| [I'M IN: SIGN ME UP AS A VICTORY CAPTAIN >>](https://us.list-manage.com/r1JyaO_y1tE?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843)
---
| |
The clock is running, and I want my strongest supporters in place before the final push begins.
Thank you for being on this team. Let's finish this together.
Kailee BullerRepublican Candidate for Congress, NY-22

There's a map that goes viral every few years: "Fastest-Growing Religion in Each State." Four little icons. A Buddha on the Pacific rim -- Washington, Oregon, California, Alaska, Hawaii. An Om in the Nevada-Arizona corridor. Star of David down the Northeast corridor, with a few surprises in Texas, Minnesota, Florida. And a crescent scattered across almost everything else -- the South, the Plains, the interior.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7aadaf9f-b59b-4ff7-af49-250582a45222?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
People share it as trivia. Read it again. Those aren't trivia. Those are addresses. Each icon marks where a people settled, and behind each people marches an ancient quarrel that never signed the guest book. The map doesn't show the growth of faith in America. It shows the importation of the world's grudges -- clustered by highway, airport, and chain migration -- into towns that had never heard of them...

Then again the next day.
And the next.
**We can’t let those lies go unanswered.** But to stay on pace and fight back, we need to raise at least as much as they’re spending, every day, from now until the polls close.

body:
| | | |
---
**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** Saturday, October 17, 2026 Contact: Maddy Rosen maddy@caitconley.com **
**
### CAIT CONLEY JOINED BY NYS AFL-CIO & LEADING LABOR UNIONS FOR MASSIVE RALLY & CANVASS LAUNCH
************************_[**Photos & Video**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.yjJN_MEbNx94PLaWzZ6hW1GJm7fH52LAiTq9C8yR9M_6Q8RWLrQYcP0Fie98AEGWeustGpkNrLoqGSjhmVRFzxu2wGKCOW8U6iePdhGFDaAtpYD5RkrNQZlpqkoiIk2Mtz5BmxgdlUMBvwnFD3QaJaydLbnZqnThlh1fUy7ejcuW7uyBeNFTXVPHhnTOM6sXiMZo_J7Y5bkZCl3TfDaEcW80KspKXf1LFSuZ3lbk9bd7IF7RlD85B13BL_LMdFdKRUr0I6FO1f_tdDdVbRcup4BeyP6G0auOVwj7dvYy9jHyPRGq3sufMqpDthY4ziYirVRotzxKjmrsFK0AV5D1To7BGjQQrvdOV798ZRCZ870w-c12VVcbCtBdQQAzYo90dv8GjWJnCW1IVQkeQztd7LXcrt7UIqxLLQkyN2s9dqKlmPvZWiEb0--KcPZGa3Y5AzuESnv17PLO9pZuOJog4Zj9nj4eRGoYmMtfPAw7TeCknjQOcekAbGRzs9BKXM3C/4uy/kBHoEgu5RuKoJntcEtm_UQ/h0/h001.yG5BAxJQ1C2b3bWsKT86x2eRTWMgTIQHbUxhEfpa-xs)_ ******OSSINING, NY** **–** Cait Conley, Army combat veteran and Democratic nominee for New York’s 17th Congressional District, was joined by the New York State AFL-CIO and hundreds of members of New York’s leading labor unions this morning for a massive rally and canvass launch. Speaker after speaker underscored Cait’s commitment to fighting for unions and working families by protecting the right to organize and lowering costs, cementing her as the sole grassroots candidate in the race to represent the Hudson Valley. “Growing up in the Hudson Valley, the daughter of a postal worker and a construction worker, I learned the values of hard work and service to community at a young age — values I’ve carried with me throughout my lifetime of service to our country. That’s why I have the utmost respect for our organized laborers, the hardworking men and women who are the backbone of our communities. I am incredibly proud to have the support of the New York State AFL-CIO, NYSUT, UFT, CSEA, 32BJ SEIU, and so many more of New York’s leading labor unions in this race. In Congress, I will stop at nothing to defend the right to organize, lower costs for working families, protect our public schools, and create a better, more affordable future for the Hudson Valley,” said **Cait Conley, Democratic nominee for New York’s 17th Congressional District.** “The New York State AFL-CIO proudly endorsed Cait Conley for New York's 17th Congressional District, where we represent over 150,000 union members and their families. Cait understands the issues that matter to working people, including lowering costs, protecting public education, supporting critical infrastructure, and investing in public services. As working people have been under constant attack from the administration in Washington, Cait is the voice we need to stand up for our dignity, rights, and respect. That’s why union members have been and will continue to be out in force in the 17th, knocking on doors and making calls to engage our members to ensure a victory on Election Day,” said **Mario Cilento, President of the New York State AFL-CIO.** “Cait Conley spent 16 years and six deployments defending this country, and she’s running for Congress because she refuses to sit on the sidelines while it’s being taken apart. She’s a proud product of our public schools, where NYSUT members invested in a student and built a citizen, and now she’s home fighting for the kids and families who need her. Our members know what’s at stake, and we’re going to send Cait to Washington,” said **Melinda Person, President of New York State United Teachers (NYSUT).** “We need Cait Conley in Washington. She will protect public education, defend our rights, and fight attempts to undermine our democracy. We will be out knocking on doors encouraging our colleagues to vote for Cait Conley in New York's 17th Congressional District,” said **Michael Mulgrew, President of the United Federation of Teachers (UFT).** “Cait Conley has been a public servant all of her life. And we’re out in the neighborhoods talking about not only her background in protecting this country, but executing her shared vision for Congressional District 17. The communities in the Hudson Valley, from labor to neighbors, deserve a trusted leader to truly represent them. Cait is right for the moment, Cait will win this race,” said **Israel Melendez, Vice President of 32BJ SEIU.** **** ### **About Cait Conley** Cait Conley is a Hudson Valley native, the daughter of a postal worker and a construction worker. She applied to West Point the day after 9/11 and went on to serve in the Army, first as a military police officer and then in special operations leadership, deploying six times and earning three Bronze Stars. Cait concluded her active-duty career as Director for Counterterrorism at the National Security Council, where Russia sanctioned her for her work, and then served as a senior executive at the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency, protecting critical infrastructure and the systems that run our elections. Tomorrow, we're knocking doors in West Chester, and we need all hands on deck. We'll give you a short training, a walk list, and everything you need. Bring a friend, wear comfortable shoes, and come ready to meet your neighbors. Friend,
Earlier this month, something momentous happened that I wanted to share with you: **Former Kansas Republican Gov. Mike Hayden endorsed me for Kansas’ U.S. Senate seat over my opponent, Sen. Roger Marshall.**
Gov. Hayden’s endorsement means so much to me because he believes in putting people over politics and delivering for working families, just as I do. Knowing he recognizes that I’m committed to fighting for real solutions for Kansans — and that I will make listening to them a priority if I’m elected — is an absolute honor.
_“I ran for office for the first time when I was only 28 years old because I felt the person representing my community in the legislature was failing to fight for the needs of our state,” he said. “Today, I am endorsing Adam Hamilton for the U.S. Senate for the same reasons.”_
His announcement comes just weeks after Republican former Gov. Bill Graves endorsed me, saying that Sen. Marshall had “turned his back” on Kansas.
I agree: Voting to slash the healthcare assistance that so many people in our state rely on is turning your back on your constituents. Supporting tariffs that drive up prices and make it harder for families to put food on the table and buy household essentials is, too. And not fighting for Kansas farmers, ranchers and small businesses — well, so is that.
**Gov. Hayden understands that standing up for Kansans against the cruel and disastrous policies coming out of Washington might not be easy, but that doesn’t make giving in okay. Kansans deserve a leader who will put them ahead of Washington. If I’m elected, that’s exactly what I’ll do.**
Friends, Gov. Hayden’s and Gov. Graves’ endorsements are proof that the foundation of this campaign — listening to folks, thinking critically about how to make their lives better and _fighting to do so even when it’s hard_ — is resonating with people across political parties.
And they aren’t the only ones who think so:
💥 Kansas Gov. Laura Kelly gave me her endorsement
💥 Former Kansas Govs. Kathleen Sebelius, Mark Parkinson and John Carlin have all officially endorsed me
💥 Arch “Pond” Naramore, a lifelong Republican who ran against Sen. Marshall in the primary, has as well
Each of these people is supporting me not because of political party but because they believe that leaders should fight for the people they represent — and they know Roger Marshall isn’t getting the job done.
But I’ll be honest: As honored as I am to have their public support, there’s one endorsement I want more than any other in the final stretch of this race:
**_Yours._**
I’m running for U.S. Senate to make _your_ life better. To be a voice for _you_ in Washington. To be the true champion that _you_ deserve.
It would mean the world to me if you would add your name to endorse my campaign — and affirm your belief that it’s time for a leader who will open their heart to the people they’re elected to represent, build bridges and stand up for their constituents amid the chaos and corruption in Washington.

---
Friend,
We'll be blunt: three major stories just broke in Florida's U.S. Senate race – a must-win to hold the Senate majority. **And they 've got us on edge.**
1\. A new poll has Senator Ashley Moody at 47% and democratic socialist Angie Nixon at 45%. Two points. Inside the margin of error.
**2\. Nixon just OUTRAISED Senator Moody last quarter.**
3\. Bernie Sanders is pouring his $23M war chest into Florida to drag her over the finish line.
Any one of these would be a warning sign. **All three at once? That 's how a political earthquake starts.**
Last month, the same pollster had it 45.2% to 44.8%. Before that, another poll had it dead even, 47–47. Each one calls Florida's U.S. Senate race a coin flip.
Sure, we could make ourselves feel better by pointing to other polls with Senator Moody further ahead. But pollsters wrote Nixon off in her primary too. She was outraised 16 to 1 – and still won by 12 points. Now she's got real money behind her. The Left's money machine is lining up, and Bernie's coming with it.
Bernie is going all in. He's flooding Florida with organizers and texts. And he's here in person, rallying with her across the state.
We've watched Bernie do this before. AOC got her start organizing for his 2016 campaign – now she's the face of the radical Left. He went all in for Zohran Mamdani, a democratic socialist – and Mamdani is now running New York City. He's backing hard-left Senate candidates in Michigan, Minnesota and Maine. body:
If you just finished attending a No Kings event and are wondering how to keep fighting, here’s how:
#
Hi there,
**Today, millions of people poured into communities across the country for No Kings events.** In blue states, red states, and everywhere in between, people rose up together to send a message that we will not surrender our democracy, our fundamental rights, and our freedoms to MAGA extremism.
And today wasn’t just about showing up. No Kings set out to turn that energy into action by getting people to make a plan to vote—and people across the country did just that.
Early voting is already underway, and over the next few weeks, millions more people will cast their ballots. This weekend’s events showed our strength as a community, but winning elections is how we actually stop Trump and strip right-wing extremists of their unchecked power. The best way to do that is to channel every ounce of today’s energy into the districts and states with some of the most competitive races in the country.
**If you just finished attending a No Kings event and are wondering how to keep fighting, we have two immediate ways to get involved:**
1️⃣ [**Join a Ground Truth canvass.**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2737?t=1&akid=3184%2E1562180%2Efmmymr) If you live in or near one of our target swing districts, joining a canvass is the single highest-impact action you can take. We’ll provide you with all of the resources you need so you can talk with voters and help make the case for Democrats.
2️⃣ [**Join a virtual phone bank.**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2738?t=2&akid=3184%2E1562180%2Efmmymr) If you don’t live near one of our target swing districts, you can get involved from the comfort of your home and join a virtual phone bank with Ground Truth. We have a phone bank tomorrow, Sunday, October 18th at 2 PM ET, but if you’re unable to join and are still interested in phone banking anytime from now to Election Day, we host weekly phone banks on Wednesdays and Sundays!
Thank you for taking action!
The Swing Left Team

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. [**If you’d like to help support our work, you can make a donation using this link.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_sl_footer?refcode=em20261017-1&t=3&refcode2=3184_1562180_fmmymr&akid=3184%2E1562180%2Efmmymr)

Donald Trump and Andy Barr just walked off the rally stage.
As per usual, the rally was filled with nonsensical rambling from our president, a sycophantic speech from Andy, all in front of a half-empty audience.
But let's be clear: **the reason why Trump flew into Kentucky today is because he 's scared that I'm going to win.** Instead of rallying in swing states two weeks ahead of Election Day, Trump is in so-called "deep-red" Kentucky.
Andy has Trump, billionaires, corporations, and dark money donors to turn to for help. _I only have you._
That means I need your support in moments like these, when my opponent has the full force of the MAGA machine behind him, and they're all over the news attacking me.
I need to fight back, and I need to do it now.
**Unfortunately, where we stand right now doesn 't allow us to dominate the airwaves like they are. But we can make sure their attacks don't go unanswered in the next 17 days.**
Is there anything you can spare by midnight tonight to help me respond before it's too late?

Derek, every
campaign budget has one line that nobody ever asks about.

It’s not the ads. It’s not the mail. It’s Election Day itself — the people
stationed at polling places, the hotline for voters who get turned away or
told their ballot has a problem, the rides for folks who can’t get there
on their own.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/18371?t=1001&akid=659%2E245147%2Eb4HjFC ]It’s the one thing we can’t fall short on, because that day only comes
once and there’s no second chance to fund it again. A shortfall anywhere
else in this budget means one fewer mail piece or a smaller GOTV
operation. A shortfall here means a Pennsylvanian who showed up to vote
and had nobody in their corner, so can we count on you to pitch in?

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/18371?t=1002&akid=659%2E245147%2Eb4HjFC ]Donate →

This is the line item where Pennsylvania is different from almost anywhere
else.

Here in the Commonwealth, we know better than anyone: Donald Trump is

In 2020, he came after our mail-in ballots.

He pushed outrageous, debunked conspiracy theories.

Hell, he even went to court 43 times to throw eligible Pennsylvanians’

body:
Recently, we learned that the Department of the Interior plans to break ground on Trump’s “triumphal” arch just outside the gates of Arlington any day now.
#
Peter,
My name is Karen Meredith, and I am a Gold Star mother. My son is one of more than 400,000 buried at Arlington National Cemetery.
My only child, 1LT Ken Ballard, joined the Army after graduating high school in 1995. As an Army granddaughter, Army daughter, Army sister, and Army mom, I couldn't have been more proud of his decision.
My son deployed to Iraq in May of 2003, and 384 days later he was killed while fighting an Iranian-backed militia in Najaf. He had been scheduled to return home one month earlier, but his tour was extended.
For families like mine, Arlington is more than a cemetery. It is where Ken is at eternal peace. It is a place an entire country comes to express its gratitude for a debt that cannot be repaid.
Donald Trump wants to destroy that peace. Recently, we learned that the Department of the Interior plans to break ground on Trump’s “triumphal” arch just outside the gates of Arlington any day now.
Trump never served. He called my son and all who served alongside him “suckers” and “losers." He trampled the graves of the fallen in Section 60 for a campaign photo opportunity. That same man would use their graves as the backdrop for his own vanity project.
The indignity of this arch is difficult to put into words, but I am grateful to have an outlet for resisting it in my work with VoteVets. They are building a nationwide mobilization against this arch, and I’d be grateful if you could contribute to support them.
[**Will you please make a contribution, $5 or whatever you can afford, directly to VoteVets? If any organization can stop this arch, it is VoteVets.**](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-oct26.xXsDMU&refcode=em261017-2-180&t=1&akid=35706%2E3013755%2EVCHYr6)

* **STOP illegal grocery store mergers** so that food prices aren’t further manipulated.
* **FIGHT for massive data centers to pay their own way** to stop families from getting stuck with increased utility bills.
* **TAKE ON illegal corporate greed** that puts profits ahead of Colorado families.

body:
Michigan Democratic Party Get Out the Vote rally with our full statewide ticket
# [ ](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1218?t=1&akid=3604%2E251025%2E9uwc7h)
[](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1744?t=3&akid=3604%2E251025%2E9uwc7h)
Peter,
Michigan’s got something to say!
[**Join the Carpenters Union and the Michigan Democratic Party tomorrow at 12:30 in Detroit for a Get Out the Vote rally with our full statewide ticket—Abdul El-Sayed, Jocelyn Benson, Garlin Gilchrist, and Eli Savit**](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1744?t=4&akid=3604%2E251025%2E9uwc7h)[**.**](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1744?t=5&akid=3604%2E251025%2E9uwc7h)
**[RSVP REQUIRED](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1744?t=6&akid=3604%2E251025%2E9uwc7h)**
We’re fighting to get **money out of politics,** for good paying jobs, stronger unions, and an economy that works for all of us who make Michigan special.
Meanwhile **Republicans are set on continuing a trade war with Canada,** our biggest trading partner. All of us are feeling the effects as costs rise at the grocery store, in healthcare, and all across the state.
We _can't_ stand by and silently watch. We must show the country the fighting spirit that defines this state. We won’t let Trump bully us and our allies. We can’t afford these costs just because he wants to rename the Great Lakes. It’s time for a kind of politics that actually listens to all people and acts based on their needs.
We’re counting on _you_ to come out tomorrow, Peter. [**Democracy only works when people show up, so invite your friends, family, coworkers and neighbors to tomorrow’s rally.**](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1744?t=7&akid=3604%2E251025%2E9uwc7h)
**[LET'S RALLY](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1744?t=8&akid=3604%2E251025%2E9uwc7h)**
See you tomorrow!
Abdul’s Organizing Team

Safety, affordability, and freedom with a Republican governor.

protecting herself, her Comrades in NYC, and her precious political

I'm running for Governor of New York because we've got one chance to

[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

You may know me as the Republican Nassau County Executive who fought
against sanctuary policies, rejected mask mandates, stopped boys from
playing in girls' sports, hired hundreds of new police officers to
make Nassau the safest county in America, and accomplished all of that
without raising taxes by a single penny.

Nassau County has 110,000 more registered Democrats than Republicans,
yet I won the race for County Executive twice, winning my re-election

SO NOT ONLY IS RADICAL KATHY HOCHUL IN THE WORST POLITICAL POSITION

We've got the winning recipe here, but it all depends on whether or

Hochul thinks she can buy this office again. In 2022, she raised $54

of wealthy liberals who can afford to keep illegals, career criminals,

And on top of that, she tried to get her cronies on the New York State
Public Campaign Finance Board to deny my campaign over $7 million in
matching funds we rightfully earned!

Thankfully, the courts reinstated us and shut down her dirty political
games.

She resorted to these corrupt tactics because the polls prove that New
Yorkers are sick of her misery.

Now that it failed, imagine just how much more money she will raise
over the next three months to buy a victory she doesn't deserve.

THERE'S A REASON WHY SHE AND HER CAMPAIGN HAVE BEEN IN "PANIC MODE"
EVER SINCE I ANNOUNCED MY CANDIDACY AND RECEIVED THE ENDORSEMENT OF
PRESIDENT TRUMP...

It's because I will reverse all the damage she's done to New York:

I will hire more cops to arrest career criminals and keep them in
jail.

I will partner with ICE to deport violent illegal aliens who do
nothing but drain our resources and harm innocent New Yorkers.

I will root out all fraud in our state social programs and prosecute
fraudsters and accomplices to the fullest extent of the law.

I will protect women and children from "transgender" predators in
women's bathrooms and sports.

I will end the "Green New Scam" madness and unleash our energy
independence to immediately lower your bills.

I know this is the winning platform that all New Yorkers desperately
need... but we've got to raise enough money to run this race and fight
back against Hochul's attacks.

WILL YOU RUSH BACK YOUR BLAKEMAN FOR GOVERNOR EMERGENCY CAMPAIGN
CONTRIBUTION?
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

With just weeks left until the election, we don't have a minute to
waste. That's why it was worth it for me to send you this
triple-stamped return envelope today.

Any amount you can send today from $5 to $250 get us one step closer
to defeating Kathy Hochul once and for all.

The average donor gives $35 or $50. Could you give that much today?

New Yorkers have never been in a better position to win this race.

We are on the cusp of flipping New York and taking back our state. By
this time next year, New Yorkers could finally be walking our
neighborhoods without fear and paying our bills without scraping by.

And WE CAN FINALLY KICK THIS SOCIALIST SCOURGE TO THE CURB AND STOP
THE EMPIRE STATE FROM BECOMING A SOCIALIST NIGHTMARE.

Help me defeat Kathy Hochul and put New York First. Thank you for
joining me.

For New York,

Bruce Blakeman

radicals will destroy New York if we give Hochul four more years as

from Long Island, I refuse to let the Empire State be turned into a

[Here is a helpful link](https://us.list-manage.com/41kxXbj4VTe?e=6736d7bc47&c2id=6d83a76682c29c59feb3e3d11de85f73) that will assist you in getting where you need to go.

I also wanted to provide a quick update as well as some photos from the campaign trail. I attended a rally this morning in Reno, followed by a get-out-the-vote event in Carson City.
---
|
---
| _Above: Here I am in Reno with my good friend,
Assemblywoman Jill Dickman, and her adorable dog Rocky._
---
|
---
| _Talking with some fired-up voters in Carson City._
---
| The most important thing I want to share with you is that in both places, I saw big crowds and a lot of enthusiasm among the voters we need to turn out this year in order for us to win. This is very encouraging, of course, but we can’t get over-confident.

The political environment is still a challenging one for Republicans, and all indications are that my race is going to be extremely close. I’m not taking anything for granted, which is why I’ll be campaigning hard right through Election Day!

As always, if you’d like to pitch in a contribution to help me out, that would be greatly appreciated. [You can do so here.](https://us.list-manage.com/CFQCnYLhfx0?e=6736d7bc47&c2id=6d83a76682c29c59feb3e3d11de85f73) Every dollar we raise from here on out is going into our direct voter-contact effort — so you can be sure your donation is going right where it counts the most!

Thank you for all your support, my friend. I’ll continue to keep you posted on my efforts in these final weeks. Until next time, take care!

For Nevada’s future,

Andy

Friends, I’ve spent the last several years working hard on legislation to address the transformative AI landscape because I knew there would come a time when Congress would need to act urgently and with authority. **I believe that moment is right now. ** Donald Trump is urging us to trust the very same AI companies whose rogue agents recently hacked our federal websites, other foreign governments, and universities. He thinks we need to let these companies “self-police” to beat China in this AI race instead of establishing protective guardrails. _I disagree — because we can’t “win” the AI race if no one trusts these systems enough to use them, or if we lose control of the technology altogether._ Yesterday, Newsweek published my new op-ed about what Washington is getting wrong about the AI race, and what Congress needs to do to ensure safety and trust are our competitive advantage. I’d love for you to read it — you can do so by [clicking here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141643336/654243209/-1977907347?refcode=261017em_sjj_oped-s&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTMxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NzI4NjZkYy03YWNhLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AtnXUkzN3luNFOqYfrRxsLG4-DwlgLxPHVk_n3GMUcw=&emci=952866dc-7aca-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&emdi=972866dc-7aca-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&ceid=14239920). _**[And if you agree that Congress needs to act on AI, the best thing you can do is to help Democrats take back the House in November. clean_body: | | | | = Friends, I’ve spent the last several years working hard on legislation to address the transformative AI landscape because I knew there would come a time when Congress would need to act urgently and with authority. I believe that moment is right now. Donald Trump is urging us to trust the very same AI companies whose rogue agents recently hacked our federal websites, other foreign governments, and universities. He thinks we need to let these companies “self-police” to beat China in this AI race instead of establishing protective guardrails. I disagree — because we can’t “win” the AI race if no one trusts these systems enough to use them, or if we lose control of the technology altogether. Yesterday, Newsweek published my new op-ed about what Washington is getting wrong about the AI race, and what Congress needs to do to ensure safety and trust are our competitive advantage. I’d love for you to read it — you can do so by . = = Thank you so much for reading — and for being in this fight with me. -Sara = | | | Congresswoman Sara JacobsCalifornia’s 51st District = | = Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress Sara Jacobs for Congress PO Box 120085 San Diego, CA 92112 United States | | | | | | ---|---|--- We believe these emails are a critical way for Sara to stay in touch with supporters and constituents. | | Friend, I was in the room last Friday night when it happened.The Minnesota GOP’s Lincoln Reagan Dinner is one of the biggest nights of the year for Republicans in our state, and I was helping emcee it. Speaker Lisa Demuth was in the middle of her speech when a group of far-left activists rushed the stage. They had tickets bought for them by deep pocket socialists to get in. Then the radicals stormed the stage with KKK signs at a dinner named after Abraham Lincoln while our state’s first African-American Speaker of the House was presenting.This is how the socialist left operates now. When they can’t win the argument, they try to make sure you never get to finish your sentence. The groups that took credit are aligned with the Democrat Party. They want what every Democrat on the ballot here wants, which is Republicans without any seat at the table in Minnesota.Friday was the loud version. The quiet version is playing out across southern Minnesota right now with outside Soros money that’s been pouring in against me for weeks. I’m not going to be shouted down. I’m not going to be outspent without a fight, either.Here’s how you can help me push back. Our last full fundraising report before Election Day is due this Thursday. Washington Democrats will read it to decide how much more to throw at this seat. I want that report to show them that last Friday night backfired.**Will you chip in before the deadline?**

body:

Hi Peter Willis,

We are in the final stretch to Election Day — and it's time to organize
like everything is on the line (because it is)!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39877?t=1013&akid=11449%2E5885482%2EER0SvS ]Join Our Revolution LIVE for our March to the Midterms this Monday,
October 19 at 8:30 PM ET / 5:30 PM PT — bringing together national
progressive leaders, candidates, organizers, and our grassroots movement
as we launch our final GOTV push.

In these closing weeks, Our Revolution is mobilizing our people-powered
voter turnout operation across the country — making calls, sending texts,
knocking doors, and organizing voters to flip Congress and build the
political power we'll need beyond Election Day.

We’ve assembled an incredible lineup to talk about what’s at stake — and
how we win:

⭐ Sen. Chris Van Hollen on the fight for the Senate, taking on Trump and
MAGA, and what’s at stake in these final weeks.

⭐ Rep. Becca Balint, Congressional Progressive Caucus member, on the CPC’s
Task Force to End Corporate Greed and the fight to lower costs for working
families.

⭐ Leah Greenberg, Co-Executive Director of Indivisible, on the nationwide
grassroots No Kings mobilization to turn out voters and defeat MAGA at the
ballot box.

⭐ Melat Kiros for Congress (CO-01) on her campaign and the opportunity to
bring a new generation of progressive leadership to Congress.

⭐ Randy Villegas for Congress (CA-22) on his campaign to flip a critical
House seat and fight for working families in California’s Central Valley.

⭐ Eli Savit for Michigan Attorney General on the stakes of state-level
races and the importance of electing leaders to hold powerful interests
accountable.

⭐Vikki Goodwin (Texas Lt. Governor) — A four-term progressive state rep
running to fully fund public schools and put Texas families ahead of
corporate interests.

⭐ Kennedy Moore for Missouri State House (HD-73) on building progressive
power from the ground up and why down-ballot organizing matters in the
final GOTV sprint.

This year marks 10 years since Bernie Sanders founded Our Revolution.
Since then, we’ve helped elect more than 1,200 progressives — from city
councils to Congress — while building a national organizing operation and
voter turnout machine.

Now, everything we’ve built is being put to work.

With Election Day just weeks away, our focus is clear: turn out every
possible voter, flip Congress, elect a new wave of progressives, and build
the grassroots power to take on Trump, MAGA, and corporate power.

8:30 PM ET / 5:30 PM PT

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39877?t=1014&akid=11449%2E5885482%2EER0SvS ]RSVP to join our March to the Midterms and help power the final GOTV
push!

The final stretch is here. Every call. Every text. Every door. Every vote.
It all matters.

When we organize, we win.

I'm honored to have President Obama's support in this critical campaign. Take a minute to watch his message for New Hampshire, then chip in what you can.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/347507da-c0aa-4faf-b961-b09977a97e34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

President Obama laid out what's on the line for Granite Staters this November: Costs that are too high, and corporate special interests rigging the system. As he said, winning this Senate race is how we bring change to Washington. That's why your vote matters.
New Hampshire doesn't have early voting -- 90% of voters will make their voices heard on Tuesday, November 3rd. Our 2016 Senate race was decided by just 1,017 votes. **We 're taking nothing for granted.**
And if you're able, outside groups have already spent millions to help John Sununu. **[A grassroots contribution of $5, $15, or whatever you can chip in helps us reach every voter before Election Day.](https://substack.com/redirect/0f3b9ebf-79b8-4d77-b7e1-be5b6c67dda8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ JOIN OBAMA AND SUPPORT MY CAMPAIGN](https://substack.com/redirect/0f3b9ebf-79b8-4d77-b7e1-be5b6c67dda8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I'm proud to have President Obama's support in this final stretch.
Now with 17 days left, we need to keep this momentum going to keep New Hampshire blue and flip the Senate. This campaign is powered by Granite Staters, so please join President Obama in supporting my campaign today. We couldn't do it without you.
Let's finish strong.
Chris

**John Sununu has taken the lead in the polls thanks to over $60 million in GOP spending -- and we know even more money is hitting the airwaves soon.**

Friends, I entered this race and hope to enter the Senate with one guiding principle: _What is best for the people of my state?_ Let me backtrack a bit and explain how we got to this point.
**_How we got here_**
Like many great ideas, this one started at home with my wife, LaVon.
Countless times over the last two years I have looked at what is happening in Washington and thought, _this is wrong_. This is not how our country is supposed to work. And it’s not a Republican thing or a Democrat thing; I believe _all of us_ care about decency and humanity. _No one_ is rooting for higher gas and grocery prices or people getting kicked off their health insurance.
The difference is that this time, LaVon responded, **“Maybe _you’re_ the somebody. Maybe _you_ need to do something.”**
**_How it’s going_**
It’s been a whirlwind since we launched this campaign. We went from zero to 60 very quickly thanks to a grassroots team that has shown incredible commitment.
The very same day I became the official Democratic Senate nominee, a new super PAC formed with the sole purpose of opposing me. They quickly went live with attack ads and are spending over $23 million so far.
But there was good news too. National election forecasters like the Cook Political Report and Sabato’s Crystal Ball upgraded our chances of winning, moving Kansas out of the “Safe Republican” category in their rankings. Just last week, Crystal Ball upgraded our race to “Toss Up.” RealClearPolitics has shifted us from “Likely R” to “Leans R” to “Toss Up.” Nate Silver shifted the race in our direction. Even Fox News took notice and moved this race in our direction.
**_What’s next?_**
I’m not going to pretend winning will be easy. Things worth fighting for rarely are. The next 17 days will be busy, exhausting and expensive. If there’s one thing I’ve learned in my few months of running for office, it’s that running a campaign takes A LOT of resources (and winning will take even more).

Countless times over the last two years I have looked at what is happening in Washington and thought, this is wrong. This is not how our country is supposed to work. And it’s not a Republican thing or a Democrat thing; I believe all of us care about decency and humanity. No one is rooting for higher gas and grocery prices or people getting kicked off their health insurance. The difference is that this time, LaVon responded, “Maybe you’re the somebody. Maybe you need to do something.” How it’s going It’s been a whirlwind since we launched this campaign. We went from zero to 60 very quickly thanks to a grassroots team that has shown incredible commitment. The very same day I became the official Democratic Senate nominee, a new super PAC formed with the sole purpose of opposing me. They quickly went live with attack ads and are spending over $23 million so far. But there was good news too. National election forecasters like the Cook Political Report and Sabato’s Crystal Ball upgraded our chances of winning, moving Kansas out of the “Safe Republican” category in their rankings. Just last week, Crystal Ball upgraded our race to “Toss Up.” RealClearPolitics has shifted us from “Likely R” to “Leans R” to “Toss Up.” Nate Silver shifted the race in our direction. Even Fox News took notice and moved this race in our direction. What’s next? I’m not going to pretend winning will be easy. Things worth fighting for rarely are. The next 17 days will be busy, exhausting and expensive. If there’s one thing I’ve learned in my few months of running for office, it’s that running a campaign takes A LOT of resources (and winning will take even more). =, but we appreciate your time and your help amplifying our message just as much. If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = Gratefully, Adam | Adam Hamilton is a husband, father, pastor and fifth-generation Kansan. Now, he’s running for U.S. Senate as an independent-minded Democrat. Just like you, he’s tired of the chaos and corruption in Washington that is harming our farmers, raising costs at the checkout line and making critical health care services unattainable. He hears your concerns and is ready to get to work for you. Recent polling shows Adam neck-and-neck in this race, and with your help, we can win big this November. = | | = | | = | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com Rather donate by check or by mail?
